economy.zh:
今日经济新闻板块的核心线索围绕三重冲击展开：**地缘冲突突然升级**（美伊空袭导致霍尔木兹海峡紧张）、**美国政坛意外震动**（参议员林赛·格雷厄姆去世）以及**科技股分化加剧**（SK海力士纳斯达克首秀后暴跌，中国硬科技却获外资创纪录涌入）。美油跳涨与全球风险资产承压形成鲜明对比，而亚太市场已率先反应。需密切关注本周美联储任务组会议纪要及欧洲央行对AI与货币政策的讨论。

- **美伊冲突引爆能源与避险情绪**：美国与伊朗实施空袭后油价跳涨，亚洲股市普遍下滑。投资者需警惕供应链中断对化工、航运的连锁影响——同花顺社区已出现合成橡胶暴涨超3%的期股联动信号。来源： [Washington Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxQM0xLdUt2VWF6ZGlPVnBoYnBFWVFOejB6RG0ySjlRR25TTXNZNElhdlpDYkxyN19oVEEwcXRydzVpTUVocG91bnpZVTBpWF9PM2RJaXdScC1GTEZmQnZGZXpYWDQzSDY3Z3VCX2dhTnVXOE5NNmRVQW9sa2VWXzZGOVZsaVN0V2NLbzFXcUNrdjJ1MmlXQjlkWUpwUUxSeVpNQ1hLNUdqZmJqWDFGaDdtSFlGbGhpOEdZNE1hLUdMRnlQY204bFE) 、 [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBnZXFqT3BPWEw5RmgwRm9oZnhRWmtVRDRjcUhhZ1VjUVRlQjJJeFV5azNUeVpSRWJGUHFDcDhuWmRPM1dXMEFDc0c2dTloOHA1OF9IOFFlMThJRkhMbVE) 
- **SK海力士首秀后暴跌12%**：这家芯片制造商在纳斯达克创纪录上市后，在首尔市场遭遇猛烈抛售，凸显AI概念股在估值与需求争议中的脆弱性。来源： [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/13/sk-hynix-shares-fall-after-stellar-nasdaq-debut.html)
- **参议员格雷厄姆去世改写国会权力格局**：这位共和党关键人物、特朗普盟友的突然离世，将影响乌克兰援助、预算和解等多项立法议程，其南卡罗来纳州席位空置引发继任者猜测。来源： [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/senator-lindsey-graham-has-died-after-a-brief-illness-his-office-says.html) 、 [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/grahams-death-policy-washington-save-america-ukraine-blanche-reconciliation.html)
- **中国硬科技巨头外资持股创历史新高**：全球资本通过沪深港通以空前速度涌入中国先进制造与科技企业，推动相关标的市值在二季度末达到纪录水平。来源： [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360310/chinese-hard-tech-giants-see-value-surge-first-half-global-investors-pour-capital)
- **“乐趣通胀”冲击居家消费**：流媒体、游戏等宅经济服务价格持续上涨，削弱了“待在家里更省钱”的传统认知。来源： [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/funflation-streaming-video-games-xbox-apple-disney-netflix.html)
- **欧元区亟需单一市场提速**：欧洲官员警告“时钟在滴答作响”，呼吁在数字转型与能源安全背景下加快一体化进程。来源： [Euronews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQZjk0MDgzbXR2RFBia25qTlhrb0k4NFVfN2hvc1dNTllxRU5BZkloVGVFSXdXRXlpdlFiR1BLYnhUcEJ4M21zM29VWmt1Z3pSQlhZMVRZamkzckdmYWllWlRWNUN2MXBRaEpSTmFHSFQtaURVX0JRUHlzaUZkZUQ1NGQ5WHZ4VEdfVjBvRUhrNEFhNE40UkFucWNORklPZXhncnpBek96SkdrSEt4OFlnZ0s2UVJka1oyajVYZDF4ZVYyR0E)

**后续观察**：短期市场焦点将锁定美伊冲突的后续发酵——若霍尔木兹海峡持续受阻，原油与化工品价格可能进一步攀升，并对全球通胀预期形成第二轮冲击。与此同时，A股与港股能否在外部压力下保持韧性，取决于中国政策面能否出台更多稳增长措施。
economy.en:
Global markets are navigating a volatile session as geopolitical shocks, political transitions, and shifting sector valuations reshape investor sentiment. A surprise U.S.-Iran airstrike cascade sent oil prices surging and Asian equities sliding, while the sudden death of influential U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham injects fresh uncertainty into fiscal and foreign policy debates. Domestically, the tech landscape is torn between record AI demand signals and sobering layoff fallout, with SK Hynix's dramatic Seoul selloff following its Nasdaq debut highlighting post-IPO adjustment pains. China's hard-tech rally continues to attract overseas capital, yet its broader A-share market faced a midday slump. Europe urgently debates market integration amid a brewing Russian financial crisis, and the 'funflation' phenomenon is squeezing household budgets in the U.S.

- **Geopolitical Risk Spike:** U.S. and Iran conducted airstrikes, driving oil prices higher and dragging Asian shares lower. The Strait of Hormuz disruption fears lifted synthetic rubber prices over 3% in China. [Dow Jones Futures Fall, Oil Prices Rise Amid New U.S.-Iran Attacks](https://news.google.)
- **Political Shock in Washington:** Senator Lindsey Graham died at 71, complicating GOP legislative goals on Ukraine aid, tax reform, and reconciliation. His successor race begins, with Nancy Mace and Gov. McMaster floated. [Sen. Lindsey Graham dies at 71](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/senator-lindsey-graham-has-died-after-a-brief-illness-his-office-says.html); [Who will replace Lindsey Graham?](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/nancy-mace-lindsey-graham-senate-seat-south-carolina-election.html)
- **Chipmaker Reversal:** SK Hynix shares tumbled 12% in Seoul after a stellar Nasdaq debut, reflecting profit-taking and valuation recalibration amid volatile AI chip demand. ['Almost unlimited' AI demand remains strong](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/ai-demand-chips-data-centers-stock-volatility.html)
- **AI Debate Intensifies:** Musk and Altman sparred after Apple filed an OpenAI lawsuit; a majority of U.S. workers now support an AI sovereign wealth fund as tech layoffs surge. [Elon Musk and Sam Altman spar](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/elon-musk-and-sam-altman-spar-.html); [Majority of U.S. workers support AI wealth fund](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/majority-of-us-workers-support-ai-fund-amid-tech-layoffs-survey.html)
- **China Hard-Tech Inflows:** Overseas capital poured into Chinese hard-tech giants via Stock Connect, driving market values to records. Meanwhile, A-shares fell 1.54% led by defense and satellite sectors. [Chinese hard tech giants see market value surge](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360310/chinese-hard-tech-giants-see-value-surge-first-half-global-investors-pour-capital); [A股午评：沪指低开低走跌1.54%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1qeXN4Y0dKYnJ3cmtVcm0zaW9pWEhLeERlSVI2UU1ETWRfRXVQZ2MzMm1wV21HaTdnVTd5NTIwcHFpVVp2bmljcUkyZ055VWZLbEl0bENQbEJlRzByYkE)
- **Europe's Urgent Single Market Call and Russia's Financial Peril:** Euronews highlights the ticking clock for a unified European market; separate intelligence reports warn that Russia's economy is an 'illusion' built on debt with a looming banking crisis. ['The clock is ticking' – Why Europe urgently needs a single market](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQZjk0MDgzbXR2RFBia25qTlhrb0k4NFVfN2hvc1dNTllxRU5BZkloVGVFSXdXRXlpdlFiR1BLYnhUcEJ4M21zM29VWmt1Z3pSQlhZMVRZamkzckdmYWllWlRWNUN2MXBRaEpSTmFHSFQtaURVX0JRUHlzaUZkZUQ1NGQ5WHZ4VEdfVjBvRUhrNEFhNE40UkFucWNORklPZXhncnpBek96SkdrSEt4OFlnZ0s2UVJka1oyajVYZDF4ZVYyR0E); [Russian economy is an 'illusion' built on debt](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNUjhKY0RpME0zTDNwSTVsSEJnM3otZUpELXhEUjhsTTAyTXZSQzRiWFktNG9Fb2o1UGJOdUV5dm83VnhaOEtQRUl5NlNyYkcxNjZMY3lDdF9SYWFicEJqektDaF82ZWUwYmlrOTZZbldCci16ZnZabkdfbGZGZVk5bU5XN0hKb3ByRDc3MEw5RENhNWxWVmVoYWRvLWNHbGxwVHo5RXN4RkpPRE93U0xaajRZTmt0Zw)
- **'Funflation' Hits Home:** At-home entertainment costs are rising as streaming and gaming services hike prices, pinching consumers already stretched by inflation. ['Funflation' hits home](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/funflation-streaming-video-games-xbox-apple-disney-netflix.html)

**Watch next:** Markets will focus on the fallout from Senator Graham's death on fiscal policy timelines, the trajectory of U.S.-Iran tensions and oil prices, and upcoming Fed task force announcements. In China, the pace of foreign inflows into hard-tech names and Shein's anticipated Hong Kong listing will be key catalysts. European policymakers face an urgent test on single-market reforms as Russia's financial stability deteriorates.

society.zh: 今日社会新闻板块呈现多重危机与结构性变迁并行之态。美伊冲突在霍尔木兹海峡对峙中骤然升级，伊朗向科威特、约旦、巴林的美军基地发动报复性打击，局势已进入不可逆的螺旋升级阶段。欧洲遭遇罕见极端天气，巴黎周边爆发“规模异常”野火，西班牙阿尔梅里亚山火致一对英国游客重伤；泰国曼谷酒吧火灾造成至少27人死亡，暴露公共安全隐患。日本宠物数量首次超过婴幼儿，催生产业链重构；韩国发布史上首个热浪紧急预警，东南部地区拉响警报。中国方面，超强台风登陆浙江，近200万人紧急转移；社会保障绿皮书发布，聚焦制度韧性。知乎回购动作持续，市场信号平淡。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in the US-Iran conflict, with tit-for-tat strikes spreading to the Strait of Hormuz and US bases in the Gulf, while a major fire in a Bangkok pub killed at least 27. In Washington, the sudden death of Senator Lindsey Graham and health scare of Mitch McConnell reshape the political landscape. Europe battles unprecedented wildfires near Paris, and a powerful typhoon forces the evacuation of nearly 2 million in China’s Zhejiang province.

- **US-Iran conflict spirals**: After fresh US strikes on Iranian port cities, Iran retaliated by hitting US military bases in Kuwait, Jordan, and Bahrain. The June ceasefire appears to have collapsed, raising the risk of a broader regional war. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cevlr112pmgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/13/iran-war-live-us-bombs-iranian-cities-again-as-hormuz-standoff-intensifies?traffic_source=rss))
- **Lindsey Graham dies suddenly**: The 71-year-old South Carolina senator and close Trump ally passed away from a suspected heart-related illness. His death removes a key figure in the MAGa era and could shift Senate dynamics. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgj25j6nmeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Bangkok bar fire kills at least 27**: A blaze ripped through a popular pub near Chatuchak market early Monday, killing 27 and injuring 63, many critically. Survivors described patrons running through flames. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c24yev53q06o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/13/at-least-27-dead-as-fire-engulfs-popular-bangkok-pub-near-chatuchak-market?traffic_source=rss))
- **Wildfires threaten Paris region**: For the first time, firefighting planes were deployed from southern France to tackle 'exceptional scale' blazes near the capital. Separately, a British couple with 40% burns was rescued from a ravine in Spain. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clye4z168edo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2x7441762o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Japan's pet industry booms as 'fur babies' outnumber infants**: Baby product makers pivot to pets amid a collapsing birthrate, a trend with deep economic and social implications for Japan. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/13/japans-pet-care-industry-booms-as-fur-babies-outnumber-infants?traffic_source=rss))
- **South Korean sailor found dead near North Korea sea border**: The missing patrolman’s discovery raises tensions on the peninsula, though details remain scarce. ([SCMP](https://news.google.))
- **China evacuates 2 million as Typhoon makes landfall**: Zhejiang province suspended work, school, and transport. The storm is one of the strongest to hit the region in years. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))

**Watch next**: The US-Iran exchange could escalate further; monitor diplomatic backchannels and oil market volatility. The aftermath of the Bangkok fire will likely prompt safety audits across Thailand. Lindsey Graham’s replacement in the Senate could shift the Republican primary landscape.

military.zh:
过去24小时全球军事格局出现剧烈震荡：美伊围绕霍尔木兹海峡的攻防战骤然升级，成为国际安全最突出的火药桶；乌克兰战场则出现打击俄方油轮的新战法，试图切断克里米亚陆桥；南海仲裁案十周年之际，14国联合声明引发中方强烈反弹，南海地缘博弈再起波澜。以下为关键动态简报。

- [伊朗对海湾国家发动攻击，美国实施数月来最重空袭](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxORUNEd2J3SmxCOVdjblNITm5abTREZkJaOXZIRzFNTWFLaTV4aTBsZnB0MXllclhjQzRZb0ppYWZObmIzeXJ5SkNNNU1QalZPRTZEdFo4Qm1tMVFzSi10YXN4aVMxU2gyOXhhTFE5RE9DUVJLT3JPLXV6OVJ0S3FrTm9jX25HUVJFSmNDZXE4eDZGZ3RVemc4enlVUlFncDh4MXZLUUdWVVpVazc2)：华盛顿邮报报道，伊朗针对海湾国家发射导弹，美军随即对伊朗防空与导弹设施进行多轮打击，双方已进入“攻击-报复”循环。
- [美伊争夺霍尔木兹海峡控制权，全球能源动脉面临直接威胁](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPcVpldGkwZktsUlRGYlRtUnlpM2Y1UF9iX0lKWmdxczBjMXl6cHhsckZ5YTZ5OVNjdWdkSzg3N3lTN21pNkNQTWVSS0NlZTlWbzBkSEUxekpYMXhLOGdpbFRRQ0FUemY3TTk2ZVByUTJLVzJhenBDQXJHOGt5TVhqT2J5RWtfeWRiRWNxdWh6TDhwdXQ5S0E)：雅虎新闻指出，双方在海峡附近的攻击已直接威胁全球约20%石油运输通道，航运保险费率飙升。
- [乌克兰宣称在亚速海击中大量俄方船舶，试图切断克里米亚陆桥](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNbVFDd21ZLUFoVmd4dWVjUmFaSGZ0eFc2QVRxMVNreWNoS2NLNjhYcWRpWmlBMlRrVl9nWXJkQ1FaZnlBbHRJRk9KTkNERjZSOW9ZUkNkbFl3VzJONkhjbm5NVU92WkUzM3VKQWVkT2dkTWVXRVd5NnRKUFVFZEdORGxwNzd4QzZrSXJTb1k1NG1rUDB2dW5rRUpSWGNfUQ)：俄方证实一艘油轮遭袭，基辅邮报分析此举意在切断俄军通往克里米亚的陆地补给线。
- [南海仲裁案裁决十周年，美日等14国发表联合声明施压中国](https://news.google.)：DW和共同社报道，14国声明指责中国南海“扩张”，中国外交部强硬回应称日本无资格置喙。
- [解放军J-16战斗机罕见展示“野兽模式”携弹量，引发关注](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMi-_)：印度时报分析认为该配置可能用于对地/对海饱和攻击，旨在威慑潜在对手。
- [美国空军LRASM和JASSM产量将翻三倍，合同总额剧增](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/)：海军新闻披露，美空军计划未来五年采购超1.1万枚远程反舰导弹和联合空面防区外导弹，针对大国竞争储备弹药。

**后续观察**：霍尔木兹海峡冲突若持续升级，可能引发更大规模军事对峙甚至断航，油价和全球供应链将遭受冲击。乌克兰针对俄油轮的攻击显示战争正向海上能源基础设施延伸。南海方向，14国声明虽无强制执行效力，但将进一步固化区域安全阵营化；中国海军近期密集展示远程打击与水下战略武器能力，是对外部压力的直接回应。美欧同时在大西洋和印太加大导弹采购与反高超音速研发投入，表明军备竞赛正从概念走向量产。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have seen a dramatic escalation in the U.S.-Iran standoff, with multiple rounds of strikes traded over the Strait of Hormuz, directly threatening global energy supplies. Concurrently, Ukraine has claimed a major drone strike on Russian ships in the Sea of Azov, while China and its neighbors marked the tenth anniversary of the South China Sea arbitration ruling with renewed rhetorical and military posturing. The Indo-Pacific naval landscape is also evolving, with new missile production surges and anti-drone systems entering development. The convergence of these flashpoints suggests a period of heightened, multi-theater volatility that defense planners must account for.

- The U.S. and Iran have exchanged heavy strikes over the weekend, with CENTCOM completing a wave of attacks targeting Iranian air defenses and missile capabilities. Iran simultaneously launched attacks on Gulf states, and both sides vie for control of the Strait of Hormuz ([WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPRFdrOUVRUGRhWjRkUTRKMHIyMGE2NDA1Qk1sYmoyRlVSdS1ndHI1dHBRLVBqdDJUYlg5RHR4aktvYWpydkZjSnFOUXNQXzFFMkVTQjBjTXdlU2l2TFhBVXNsOUpxem1vdklsOFVwR211Vmh5MkRQQV9iMTVmMWxGUWVDZXJDN3JXb1BWektnMEdmdEFnV3lVTVYtZ2ZLOUdrN3hwa2RPRGlHTzQ5SUYw), [The Washington Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxORUNEd2J3SmxCOVdjblNITm5abTREZkJaOXZIRzFNTWFLaTV4aTBsZnB0MXllclhjQzRZb0ppYWZObmIzeXJ5SkNNNU1QalZPRTZEdFo4Qm1tMVFzSi10YXN4aVMxU2gyOXhhTFE5RE9DUVJLT3JPLXV6OVJ0S3FrTm9jX25HUVJFSmNDZXE4eDZGZ3RVemc4enlVUlFncDh4MXZLUUdWVVpVazc2)).
- Ukraine claims its long-range drones struck scores of Russian ships in the Sea of Azov, targeting oil tankers and adding to Russia's energy woes ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/ukraine-claims-scores-of-russian-ships-struck-in-sea-of-azov)). Russia confirmed a tanker was hit ([The Moscow Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNbVFDd21ZLUFoVmd4dWVjUmFaSGZ0eFc2QVRxMVNreWNoS2NLNjhYcWRpWmlBMlRrVl9nWXJkQ1FaZnlBbHRJRk9KTkNERjZSOW9ZUkNkbFl3VzJONkhjbm5NVU92WkUzM3VKQWVkT2dkTWVXRVd5NnRKUFVFZEdORGxwNzd4QzZrSXJTb1k1NG1rUDB2dW5rRUpSWGNfUQ)).
- China's J-16 fighter displayed its heaviest-ever missile loadout in a 'Beast Mode' configuration, drawing regional attention ([The Times of India](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_)).
- Fourteen nations, including Japan and the U.S., issued a joint statement on the tenth anniversary of the South China Sea arbitration ruling, declaring China's maritime claims have no legal basis ([RFI](https://news.google.)). China responded dismissively, calling the ruling a "farce" ([新蓝网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1TN3ktamN4S1lrTmRUMXpDNmdub09DVFJCQkdwa2t3VF9nY0U5WWkzbEtHazBQUnpMa1EycktYeXowSWJ3bEg1NXhsM3ZGSW8)).
- The U.S. Air Force plans to more than triple production of LRASM and JASSM cruise missiles, buying over 11,000 units in the next five to seven years ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/)).
- The EU has signed a grant for the MBDA-led HYDIS hypersonic interceptor project, aiming for a three-year concept phase for the AQUILA interceptor ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/eu-signs-grant-for-mbda-led-hydis-hypersonic-interceptor-project/)).
- Despite ongoing Iranian attacks, the number of transits through the Strait of Hormuz more than doubled from May to June 2026, though still far below year-ago levels ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)).

**Watch next:** The U.S.-Iran exchange appears far from de-escalation; further strikes on Iranian air defense and missile sites are likely, with potential knock-on effects on oil prices and Gulf state security. Ukraine's Sea of Azov campaign may force Russia to redeploy naval assets, while the South China Sea diplomatic row could trigger new military drills or incidents. Monitor the Strait of Hormuz traffic data and insurance rates for shipping.

tech.zh:
📡 **科技新闻板块日报** | 2026年7月13日

AI监管抗议升级、智能戒指格局生变、Uber罕见呼吁暂缓自动驾驶、以及3DS运行Claude Code——过去24小时科技圈交织着激进与保守的张力。此外，GameCube的稀缺性、Xiaomi在美国的“隐形”以及超200人走上街头喊停AI竞赛，都指向同一个信号：行业正从“能做什么”转向“该不该做”。

- **智能戒指品类标杆**：[Oura Ring 5](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964386/oura-ring-5-review-smart-ring-wearables) 获评“最适合新手的健康追踪器”，但升级用户可能缺乏动力。这与Xiaomi [在美罕见销售](https://www.engadget.com/2210461/why-xiaomi-not-banned-rarely-sold-usa/) 的“非禁令式缺席”形成对照——市场准入并非技术问题，而是策略与监管的复合考量。
- **AI监管走向街头**：超过200名抗议者同时在OpenAI和Google DeepMind办公室前[要求暂停AI竞赛](https://news.google.)。与此同时，OpenAI悄然上线[广告平台](https://ads.openai.com/)，试图在ChatGPT中植入商业化。
- **Uber的“反直觉”策略**：Uber正[推动政策放慢自动驾驶落地](https://www.wired.com/story/ubers-autonomous-vehicle-strategy-slow-their-adoption/)，以对抗Waymo等开发商可能形成的垄断。这家曾全力押注无人车的公司，如今竟成为“刹车派”。
- **黑客与复古的碰撞**：Hacker News上“[Tiny Emulators](https://floooh.github.io/tiny8bit-preview/index.html)”以180分领跑社区，同时开发者成功在[3DS上运行SSH并调用Claude Code](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48887733)——一场掌机+AI的另类实验。
- **汽车圈电气化加速**：奔驰AMG CLA 45在Goodwood亮相，680马力、三台轴向磁通电机；Volvo电动卡车[驶入美国卡车模拟器](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/volvo-electric-semi-trucks-charge-up-american-truck-simulator/)，虚拟驾驶或成电动重卡普及的隐形推手。

**后续观察**：AI商业化与治理的矛盾在本周集中爆发。OpenAI一边被抗议，一边开卖广告位；Uber在自动驾驶上“逆向操作”可能重塑行业博弈。智能硬件方面，可维修性法规（如EU推动Apple Pencil换电池）正在从边缘议题走向主流，消费电子产品设计范式或将因此改变。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape saw significant developments across AI regulation, electric vehicle competition, and consumer electronics. Protests hit major AI labs, the Oura Ring 5 sets a new standard for smart rings, and Mercedes unveiled a groundbreaking electric performance sedan. Meanwhile, the HN community celebrated a surge in DIY hardware and classic computing projects.

- **AI Regulation Heats Up:** Over 200 protesters marched on OpenAI and Google DeepMind offices demanding a pause in the AI race, while OpenAI launched its advertising platform for ChatGPT, signaling a new commercial frontier ([MSN](https://news.google.), [OpenAI](https://ads.openai.com/)).
- **Electric Vehicle Divergence:** Mercedes' AMG CLA 45 with 680 hp and three axial-flux motors marks a performance EV milestone, while Tesla FSD's approval in Europe progresses slowly despite strong data ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/mercedes-amg-cla-45-arrives-in-goodwood-with-680-hp-and-three-axial-flux-motors/), [evxl.co](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE1GT1doTnVsVUgtVlo1WGJ2Y0pyTHFNZWZiWDZPQkdkMk1tT3NsTk50a2Y4NlUzOGNPc0xzRlF6VmFScUdCamxWUkQwVG1xVXFlZ0RZTWc0TDRqMzd6WHV0ZzBmT1NOSmxYQnR3bVJn)). Tesla and Rivian beat Q2 expectations, contrasting with Ford/GM struggles ([Benzinga](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPaTBGYUNmTkNMNHNOaVctMEFUNE1ia0tRZFlsNFhOY1NqNnZnSTlHMndUYlZUMGVlSjgwa0dqM0pvbl9scWRvdjltLVB6blg0S1dSSVdXaXBBY2tFdWttOEV0bnVCZGZHRW0tSmdULTBtblV2OHZUMFlxTjJXV1pmM1ZLeGdNeHdvMXpZRE52ODY3bmpBUEg4Z29GM2dmXzZrQl82QXRNOVdObEo2blJGeXp4OA)).
- **Apple's Product and Policy Moves:** iOS 27 introduces new child safety features, and upcoming EU regulations may force Apple Pencil redesign with replaceable batteries ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/apple-child-safety-ios-27/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2213077/refreshed-apple-pencils-may-arrive-next-year-with-improved-repairability/)).
- **Smart Rings and Wearables:** The Oura Ring 5 review confirms it as the best smart ring, appealing to newcomers and upgraders alike ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964386/oura-ring-5-review-smart-ring-wearables)).
- **Gaming and Speedrunning:** Summer Games Done Quick raised over $2 million for Doctors Without Borders; GameCube games remain rare and expensive ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2213171/summer-games-done-quick-raises-over-2-million-for-doctors-without-borders/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2210424/why-gamecube-games-so-rarely-sold/)).
- **Community Builds:** Hacker News highlighted a surge in DIY electronics, with top stories on PCB design, tiny emulators, and a programmable pocket device ([Hacker News](https://vilkeliskis.com/b/2026/0711.html), [floooh.github.io](https://floooh.github.io/tiny8bit-preview/index.html), [kode.diy](https://kode.diy/)).
- **AI and Copyright:** A Chinese voice actor must prove his humanity against AI clones; Australian radio top song suspected AI-generated ([Sixth Tone](https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1018753/TheChineseVoiceActorForcedtoProveHe%E2%80%99sHuman), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/jul/13/josh-fawaz-like-a-prayer-song-is-it-ai-radio)).

**Watch next:** The coming week will likely see continued debate on AI regulation following the protests, and the automotive industry's shift toward electric performance will be further tested by Mercedes and Tesla's market moves. The HN community's maker spirit suggests more hardware projects on the horizon.

sports.zh:
## 体育新闻日报（2026-07-13）

今日体育圈迎来多枚重磅炸弹：NBA休赛期地震级交易与续约密集爆发，FIBA世界杯四强格局首次由排名前四球队包揽，而温网男单决赛则上演了辛纳的统治级卫冕。以下为24小时内最值得关注的动态。

- **NBA：文班亚马顶薪续约、黄蜂送走鲍尔、莫兰特换队启程** —— 马刺与[文班亚马达成5年2.52亿顶薪合同](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension)，创历史第三大新秀续约；黄蜂总经理[确认交易鲍尔为了“长期冠军竞争力”](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337303/ball-trade-help-hornets-compete-championships)；[莫兰特称加盟开拓者是“重新开始”](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again)，并否认“恶人”标签。
- **NBA冲突：阿德巴约与希罗在拉斯维加斯动手** —— [前热火队友阿德巴约和希罗在酒店训练场发生肢体冲突](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas)，阿德巴约击中希罗头部，事件或影响热火更衣室氛围。
- **世界杯：FIFA前四全部闯入半决赛创历史** —— [阿根廷、西班牙、法国和英格兰作为赛事前四种子全部晋级](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49344988/fifa-top-4-teams-world-cup-semifinals-first)，这是世界杯史上首次。同时因凡蒂诺[确认将研究64队扩军](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49345374/gianni-infantino-fifa-examine-64-team-world-cup-expansion)，引发争议。
- **英格兰争议晋级：挪威主帅炮轰电视线缆助攻** —— [英格兰1-1战平挪威后，挪威主帅Solbakken认为扳平球得益于电视线缆干扰](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49339911/norway-head-coach-fumes-clear-tv-cable-assist-england-goal-jude-bellingham)；哈兰德父亲更直言球队“被抢劫”。
- **温网：辛纳卫冕男单冠军，世界第一展现韧性** —— [辛纳在法网受挫后强势回击，直落四盘击败兹维列夫](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cx2v84zje83o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，连续两年捧起温网奖杯。
- **中国篮球：男篮遭绝杀、北京男篮外援试训、斯科拉成老板** —— [中国男篮被绝杀，三后卫战术遭质疑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE83cTgxTEVsUU5aMXh3cm1sWHZYSkRIN3NXb05KUTNWZERpYlBmVGxUT2dfTkg3SEZGRXRvZXFyek51S1luUkdkLWs3cXpIRTg5dGVEaTRUWHZLVFdjRW1hVmlXbFBnQmxPLVJEdjJsdHJYZw)；[奥拉迪波自荐试训北京男篮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE05UzU5WjBvWHBXVWhpSmJ0aElfWHYwNG1tdzNoSjg1X0c2VXE5OWFPeDJwQmYySE84NlZJbkM4STUwLTZ1R2dGUnV3Q3VuOVFLWC1kaTdXOGFJN0RqeHB6S3lNaUJWWFNDbEJzYlFjX0w)；前火箭悍将[斯科拉46岁成为球队老板](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOeFp2OHFqYzZ3ZzlVNnRGTlVaR0x0aVA3WXF3aDlTZ2cyS3dBNWZ2QlRDekd3bkl6NnpTcHY3SWRlTlVkQ3p1eEVtYUdPY2hKdXBDdnlNdUFmQ3JpeldhLWhoOVVCVXpRSWJHdWdlWEVhVW1aVS1SZkZ1VHpsRHNMWDdPYVdSNTZQNThKYQ)，四个儿子传承篮球。

**后续观察：** 世界杯半决赛即将上演——阿根廷vs英格兰、西班牙vs法国，四强历史性对决将决定足坛新王；NBA夏季联赛仍在进行，状元迪班萨或已打完最后一场，关注其正式合同谈判；文班亚马的顶薪将影响明年工资帽和自由市场策略。
sports.en:
The sports world in the last 24 hours is dominated by seismic NBA moves—Victor Wembanyama's record $252M extension, LaMelo Ball's blockbuster trade, and Ja Morant's fresh start in Portland—while the World Cup semifinals set up a dream matchup of the top four FIFA-ranked nations for the first time. Meanwhile, Wimbledon crowned a repeat champion, and Chinese basketball fans are dissecting a heartbreaking national team defeat.

- **Wembanyama locks in max extension**: The Spurs' phenom agreed to a five-year, $252M rookie-scale extension, the third-largest in NBA history, cementing San Antonio's future around him. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension))
- **Hornets trade LaMelo Ball for sustained success**: GM Jeff Peterson called the decision 'probably the most difficult' of his career, but the deal aims to build multi-year competitiveness around a new core. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337303/ball-trade-help-hornets-compete-championships))
- **Morant says 'start fresh' with Trail Blazers**: The former Grizzlies star embraces a reset in Portland, eager to shed his 'bad guy' label. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again))
- **Adebayo-Herro physical altercation in Vegas**: Former Heat teammates Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro reportedly came to blows at a practice court, with Adebayo striking Herro in the head. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas))
- **World Cup semifinals: FIFA's top four finally all advance**: Argentina, Spain, France, and England—the exact top four in the world rankings—are two wins from glory, an unprecedented semifinal lineup. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49344988/fifa-top-4-teams-world-cup-semifinals-first))
- **Infantino opens door to 64-team World Cup**: FIFA will discuss expanding the men's tournament after 2026, saying every nation should have a chance to dream. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj9gm31jwg8o))
- **Sinner repeats at Wimbledon**: World No.1 Jannik Sinner beat Alexander Zverev in four sets to defend his title, bouncing back from a shock French Open loss. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cx2v84zje83o))
- **Chinese basketball reaction: national team loss and Scola's new life**: Fans lament a last-second defeat for the men's team, spotlighting a three-guard lineup failure, while 46-year-old Luis Scola becomes a team owner and builds a basketball dynasty. ([虎扑社区](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE83cTgxTEVsUU5aMXh3cm1sWHZYSkRIN3NXb05KUTNWZERpYlBmVGxUT2dfTkg3SEZGRXRvZXFyek51S1luUkdkLWs3cXpIRTg5dGVEaTRUWHZLVFdjRW1hVmlXbFBnQmxPLVJEdjJsdHJYZw))

**Watch next**: All eyes on Tuesday's World Cup semifinals (Argentina vs. England, Spain vs. France) and the continuing NBA free-agent dominoes—LeBron James' decision, Kawhi Leonard trade talks, and Jalen Duren's contract still loom large.

entertainment.zh: 今日娱乐头条由周星驰《功夫女足》霸屏——该片在中国内地首周末狂揽7.4亿人民币（约1.03亿美元），远超预期，预计总票房将突破35亿人民币，成为暑期档最强核弹。与此同时，《Love Island USA》第八季冠军揭晓，Bryce与Trinity拿下桂冠；Jay-Z在洋基体育场的第三场演唱会因粉丝冲门推迟近四小时，引发安全争议。日韩方面，《Goblin》十周年特辑完结，原班人马聚首催泪；新约会真人秀《Love Against Time》大胆聚焦绝症青年，MC阵容华丽。中国娱乐圈则被“AI冲击”与“粉丝维权”两股暗流搅动：暴雪中国裁员、演员集体喊话求工作，而瑞鹤娱乐因粉丝公开信登上热搜第一。微博社区对张小斐在《功夫女足》中的撞树演技爆发两极争吵，陈翔旧事重提再遭扒皮。后续观察：周星驰电影能否打破《战狼2》纪录？AI对演员的替代恐慌会否催生行业新规？瑞鹤娱乐的粉丝战争可能暴露偶像经纪管理的深层漏洞。
entertainment.en:
This week's entertainment landscape is dominated by Stephen Chow's massive box office return, a chaotic Jay-Z concert, and emotional farewells in K-drama reunions. The West sees cross-border blockbusters and reality TV shake-ups, while Korea churns out variety shows and new drama casts. Weibo is ablaze with fan wars and resurfaced scandals. Here's what you need to know.

- **[Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Soccer' Opens to $74M in Two Days](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/stephen-chow-kung-fu-soccer-china-box-office-1236646255/)** – The 'Shaolin Soccer' spinoff is projected to earn over $350M in China, with a U.S. release still being negotiated. Zhang Xiaofei's performance has sparked debate on Weibo.
- **[Jay-Z's Yankee Stadium Concert Delayed 4 Hours After Security Breach](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jay-z-yankee-stadium-concert-delay-security-breach-1236809269/)** – Fans rushing the gates caused the third-night delay; Jay-Z apologized for the wait.
- **[Love Island USA Season 8 Crowns Winners Bryce & Trinity](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bryce-trinity-win-love-island-usa-season-8-1236807453/)** – The Peacock reality finale drew strong engagement. A reunion special co-hosted by Andy Cohen and Ariana Madix is set for August 31.
- **[Love Island USA Producer James Barker Dies Unexpectedly](https://deadline.com/2026/07/ariana-madix-tribute-love-island-usa-producer-james-barker-1236980394/)** – Ariana Madix led tributes and called for crowdfunding for his family amid the season 8 celebration.
- **[K-Drama 'Guardian: The Lonely and Great God' Cast Concludes 10th Anniversary Trip](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854112wpp/guardian-the-lonely-and-great-god-cast-concludes-10th-anniversary-trip-with-heartfelt-farewells)** – The beloved 'Goblin' cast reunited for a special variety trip, drawing fond memories from fans.
- **[Chinese Actors 'Seek Work' as AI Threatens Jobs](https://news.google.)** – Industry reports highlight how AI is reshaping casting in China, prompting collective anxiety among performers.
- **[Blizzard China Lays Off Staff, Cites 'Optimization'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9jbnRpemRLVF81dDlCNENuNnlnRkNYbzZocFZQUk83dy1ZaVhaTlUzMU5OeFZvdGhiR3JfakZaMllhYmFPRjNIcjE0S2FfME9TZGVLaUxyQWR2emVFN3VCaHNR)** – The layoffs reflect broader corporate restructuring in China's gaming and entertainment sector.

**Watch next:** The Love Island USA reunion (Aug 31) and ENHYPEN's performance at Comic-Con (July 23-24) will dominate headlines. 'The Village Barber' Season 2 casting and 'Love Against Time' reality show premiere are also on the horizon.

美股.zh:
**概览**：美股期货下跌，油价暴涨，政治不确定性叠加地缘冲突压制风险偏好。SK海力士纳斯达克首秀后重挫12%，AI芯片股波动加剧；参议院重要人物去世可能扰动政策预期。

- **SK海力士暴跌**：在纳斯达克创纪录上市仅一天后，该股在首尔市场跌幅达12%。这暗示市场对AI芯片需求持续性存在分歧——即便企业高管喊话“需求近乎无限”。 [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/13/sk-hynix-shares-fall-after-stellar-nasdaq-debut.html)
- **国会真空**：参议员林赛·格雷厄姆逝世，其影响力横跨外交、司法与预算领域。南卡罗来纳州长可能任命临时继任者，11月中期选举前的立法议程将面临更多变数。 [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/grahams-death-policy-washington-save-america-ukraine-blanche-reconciliation.html)
- **美伊空袭推升能源**：油价跳涨，道指期货承压。投资者需警惕地缘溢价对航空、化工等板块的直接侵蚀。 [Investor's Business Daily](https://news.google.)
- **AI财富基金呼声**：调查显示多数美国工人支持设立AI主权财富基金以应对科技裁员潮，反映社会对AI收益分配公平性的关切升温。 [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/majority-of-us-workers-support-ai-fund-amid-tech-layoffs-survey.html)

**收束判断**：短期美股将在“地缘风险 vs AI叙事”中拉锯，但实际波动率可能被华盛顿政治真空放大，建议关注防御板块与能源股的表现。
美股.en:
U.S. equities face a volatile start to the week as geopolitical tensions (U.S.-Iran airstrikes) and the unexpected death of Senator Lindsey Graham create multiple sources of uncertainty. The SK Hynix post-IPO plunge and ongoing AI demand debate are weighing on semiconductor sentiment, while surveys reveal growing worker support for an AI wealth fund amid rising tech layoffs. At-home 'funflation' is adding to consumer strain.

- **Geopolitical & Political Shock:** Oil prices jumped and Dow futures fell after U.S.-Iran airstrikes; Senator Graham's death at 71 complicates GOP legislative agenda on Ukraine and reconciliation. [Oil prices jump, Asian shares slip](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxQM0xLdUt2VWF6ZGlPVnBoYnBFWVFOejB6RG0ySjlRR25TTXNZNElhdlpDYkxyN19oVEEwcXRydzVpTUVocG91bnpZVTBpWF9PM2RJaXdScC1GTEZmQnZGZXpYWDQzSDY3Z3VCX2dhTnVXOE5NNmRVQW9sa2VWXzZGOVZsaVN0V2NLbzFXcUNrdjJ1MmlXQjlkWUpwUUxSeVpNQ1hLNUdqZmJqWDFGaDdtSFlGbGhpOEdZNE1hLUdMRnlQY204bFE); [Graham dies](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/senator-lindsey-graham-has-died-after-a-brief-illness-his-office-says.html)
- **Chip Sector Volatility:** SK Hynix slides 12% in Seoul after Nasdaq debut; AI demand remains 'almost unlimited' but enterprise spending shifts to 'valuemaxxing'. [SK Hynix shares slide](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/13/sk-hynix-shares-fall-after-stellar-nasdaq-debut.html); [AI demand strong](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/ai-demand-chips-data-centers-stock-volatility.html)
- **AI Wealth Fund & Tech Layoffs:** Majority of U.S. workers back an AI sovereign wealth fund; Amazon layoffs take a toll in a saturated job market. [Workers support AI fund](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/12/majority-of-us-workers-support-ai-fund-amid-tech-layoffs-survey.html); [Amazon layoffs toll](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/burnout-frustration-and-heartbreak-amazon-layoffs-take-their-toll.html)
- **'Funflation' Pressures Households:** Streaming and gaming price hikes make staying in costlier, affecting consumer discretionary spending. [Funflation hits home](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/11/funflation-streaming-video-games-xbox-apple-disney-netflix.html)

**Signal:** Heightened geopolitical and political risks, combined with AI sector rotation and consumer strain, suggest a cautious near-term outlook for U.S. equities, with energy stocks likely to outperform.

欧洲经济.zh:
**概览**：欧洲正面临多重结构性压力——单一市场建设紧迫性上升、德国汽车人才危机加剧、俄罗斯经济“幻觉”面临银行危机暴雷风险，以及中国电动车对欧出口可能见顶的信号。

- **单一市场刻不容缓**：Euronews发表评论文章指出，在数字欧元、AI监管与能源转型的十字路口，欧盟必须加速消除内部壁垒，否则将落后于中美。 [Euronews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQZjk0MDgzbXR2RFBia25qTlhrb0k4NFVfN2hvc1dNTllxRU5BZkloVGVFSXdXRXlpdlFiR1BLYnhUcEJ4M21zM29VWmt1Z3pSQlhZMVRZamkzckdmYWllWlRWNUN2MXBRaEpSTmFHSFQtaURVX0JRUHlzaUZkZUQ1NGQ5WHZ4VEdfVjBvRUhrNEFhNE40UkFucWNORklPZXhncnpBek96SkdrSEt4OFlnZ0s2UVJka1oyajVYZDF4ZVYyR0E)
- **德国工程师逃离汽车业**：传统汽车巨头转型阵痛导致年轻工程师流失，产业竞争力面临长期侵蚀。 [Arab News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5keHVvQ2hQaUctV0Q5ZnBHWnhBLUFnMUJPRFdsYVRQMTdlTDV1YTgzOTlqWUtMdTNDdGFhWW05TTlKc2o4RmRYSmUyeE51SU9WM2lv)
- **俄罗斯经济“幻觉”将破灭**：情报报告警告俄罗斯经济增长依赖债务扩张，银行业危机一触即发，政府甚至考虑没收养老金。 [Fortune](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNUjhKY0RpME0zTDNwSTVsSEJnM3otZUpELXhEUjhsTTAyTXZSQzRiWFktNG9Fb2o1UGJOdUV5dm83VnhaOEtQRUl5NlNyYkcxNjZMY3lDdF9SYWFicEJqektDaF82ZWUwYmlrOTZZbldCci16ZnZabkdfbGZGZVk5bU5XN0hKb3ByRDc3MEw5RENhNWxWVmVoYWRvLWNHbGxwVHo5RXN4RkpPRE93U0xaajRZTmt0Zw)
- **中国电动车对欧出口或近峰值**：分析人士指出，尽管中国汽车发往欧盟的船货激增，但可能已接近上限，欧盟反补贴调查与本地化要求正在改变贸易格局。 [SCMP](https://news.google.)

**收束判断**：欧洲经济面临“内忧外患”，内部改革动能不足与外部竞争压力并存。投资者应关注欧洲央行9月利率决议前对AI变革与衰退风险的平衡措辞。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets are grappling with renewed urgency for single-market integration as the IMF and ECB warn of fragmentation risks, while intelligence reports flag an alarming deterioration in Russia's financial stability. German auto industry woes deepen, and China's car shipments to the EU may be peaking. The ECB released minutes from its June meeting and a speech on AI and monetary policy.

- **Urgent Call for Single Market:** Euronews emphasizes the need for a unified European market, with the clock ticking to boost competitiveness. ['The clock is ticking' – Why Europe urgently needs a single market](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxQZjk0MDgzbXR2RFBia25qTlhrb0k4NFVfN2hvc1dNTllxRU5BZkloVGVFSXdXRXlpdlFiR1BLYnhUcEJ4M21zM29VWmt1Z3pSQlhZMVRZamkzckdmYWllWlRWNUN2MXBRaEpSTmFHSFQtaURVX0JRUHlzaUZkZUQ1NGQ5WHZ4VEdfVjBvRUhrNEFhNE40UkFucWNORklPZXhncnpBek96SkdrSEt4OFlnZ0s2UVJka1oyajVYZDF4ZVYyR0E)
- **Russia's Economy at Breaking Point:** Intelligence reports describe Russia's economy as an 'illusion' built on debt, with a banking crisis imminent. Another report suggests Kremlin is considering pension seizures. [Russian economy is an 'illusion'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNUjhKY0RpME0zTDNwSTVsSEJnM3otZUpELXhEUjhsTTAyTXZSQzRiWFktNG9Fb2o1UGJOdUV5dm83VnhaOEtQRUl5NlNyYkcxNjZMY3lDdF9SYWFicEJqektDaF82ZWUwYmlrOTZZbldCci16ZnZabkdfbGZGZVk5bU5XN0hKb3ByRDc3MEw5RENhNWxWVmVoYWRvLWNHbGxwVHo5RXN4RkpPRE93U0xaajRZTmt0Zw); [Russia considers pension seizure](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxPYlpHY3VkdFhWb3RoOWs0T1FuNWNndlJRZHRPck1xMmlpcThON1BSZVhGYU1pdGcxZFcycEZoSkw1WFNXcjZDNEhOaHdQbTFqWk1IMlJBOS0xTWhnV1RNLTBRNzdlcEVvbG5lbmNjcHhqYUlWeGRXbUtJZndZUzFhLW1fa3pCV1Rkd0dNalZKSUlnVHZXR29IZw)
- **China Car Shipments to EU – Near Peak?** European analysts warn that surging Chinese car exports to the EU may be nearing a ceiling amid tariff risks and slowing demand. [China's car shipments to EU surge but could be nearing peak](https://news.google.)
- **German Auto Crisis Hits Engineers:** The car industry downturn is taking a toll on Germany's young engineering talent, threatening innovation. [Car crisis takes toll on Germany's young engineers](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5keHVvQ2hQaUctV0Q5ZnBHWnhBLUFnMUJPRFdsYVRQMTdlTDV1YTgzOTlqWUtMdTNDdGFhWW05TTlKc2o4RmRYSmUyeE51SU9WM2lv)
- **ECB Minutes & AI:** The ECB published its June meeting account and a speech by Philip Lane on AI and monetary policy. [Meeting of 10-11 June 2026](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/accounts/2026/html/ecb.mg260709~0e7f8241c9.en.html); [Philip Lane: AI and monetary policy](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260706~b81aa4e329.en.html)

**Signal:** Europe faces a confluence of structural headwinds—fragmentation, Russian contagion risk, auto sector weakness—making the case for urgent integration even more critical; watch for ECB commentary and any new sanctions on Russia.

中国经济.zh:
**概览**：中国硬科技板块吸引外资创纪录，但A股今日受外部冲击低开低走。Shein转向香港IPO、Five Guys进军北京等微观信号显示消费与融资市场仍在活跃，而香港楼市反弹面临可持续性质疑。

- **硬科技获外资创纪录涌入**：截至二季度末，全球投资者通过沪深港通持有的中国先进制造与科技公司市值达到历史新高。这表明中国“硬科技”正从政策驱动转向价值认可。 [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360310/chinese-hard-tech-giants-see-value-surge-first-half-global-investors-pour-capital)
- **A股承压下跌**：沪指午盘跌1.54%，军工电子、商业航天等前期热门板块领跌，反映地缘风险和获利回吐共同作用。 [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1qeXN4Y0dKYnJ3cmtVcm0zaW9pWEhLeERlSVI2UU1ETWRfRXVQZ2MzMm1wV21HaTdnVTd5NTIwcHFpVVp2bmljcUkyZ055VWZLbEl0bENQbEJlRzByYkE)
- **Shein转道香港**：在美英IPO受阻后，Shein准备在香港上市，测试监管环境与投资者情绪。 [Modaes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPMkxZVDJ4U1Utc1hPRGZnY0JBRzlkUFdHcm0zME1tT0MxLVhPRnUwUXhLdGlIQzFURUNybnBHZTVDODRJazdJWEhGdVdVWUdNam9XREUwU3V4c0ZFNENMOEZIX2d3VTZSMXZfV2E2QWlPdDdubS1FOWtMMTd4dWFrTzhOYzNaZG9aVXBZU21TMWtxeVhYSmg4czRhOHd3VExqbm9DM3ZpempsNnVQUWVqRTRjTzJvQmh0MGlqdw)
- **香港楼市反弹隐忧**：尽管房价回升速度快于预期，但分析师担心涨幅侵蚀可负担性，本地买家能否持续支撑行情存疑。 [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360211/does-hong-kongs-housing-market-rebound-need-local-owners-sustain-it)
- **五兄弟进京**：Five Guys即将在北京开设首店，与Wendy's、Chili's等美式快餐一起，瞄准中国消费市场潜力。 [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3360268/five-guys-open-beijing-more-us-chains-hunger-success-china)

**收束判断**：中国资产在外部动荡中展现出结构性吸引力（硬科技、消费品牌），但市场整体仍受全球风险偏好压制。预计下半年政策将进一步加码稳增长，以巩固外资信心。
中国经济.en:
China's markets present a contrast: overseas capital continues to flood into hard-tech giants, driving record valuations under Stock Connect, while domestic A-shares fell sharply today amid geopolitical jitters. Hong Kong is seeing new IPO and reform activity—Shein's likely listing and HSBC's board-lot change—while housing market momentum shows signs of fragility. Yuan internationalization is still a work in progress.

- **Hard-Tech Surge:** Global investors increased exposure to Chinese advanced manufacturing and tech companies, driving northbound holdings to a record high by end-Q2. [Chinese hard tech giants see market value surge](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3360310/chinese-hard-tech-giants-see-value-surge-first-half-global-investors-pour-capital)
- **A-Share Midday Slump:** Shanghai Composite fell 1.54% with defense, synthetic diamond, and commercial aerospace sectors leading losses, partly due to U.S.-Iran tensions. [A股午评：沪指低开低走跌1.54%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1qeXN4Y0dKYnJ3cmtVcm0zaW9pWEhLeERlSVI2UU1ETWRfRXVQZ2MzMm1wV21HaTdnVTd5NTIwcHFpVVp2bmljcUkyZ055VWZLbEl0bENQbEJlRzByYkE)
- **Shein's Hong Kong Debut:** Shein is poised to list in Hong Kong after facing hurdles in the U.S. and UK. [Shein Poised for Hong Kong Market Debut](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPMkxZVDJ4U1Utc1hPRGZnY0JBRzlkUFdHcm0zME1tT0MxLVhPRnUwUXhLdGlIQzFURUNybnBHZTVDODRJazdJWEhGdVdVWUdNam9XREUwU3V4c0ZFNENMOEZIX2d3VTZSMXZfV2E2QWlPdDdubS1FOWtMMTd4dWFrTzhOYzNaZG9aVXBZU21TMWtxeVhYSmg4czRhOHd3VExqbm9DM3ZpempsNnVQUWVqRTRjTzJvQmh0MGlqdw)
- **HSBC Board-Lot Reform:** Hong Kong exchange's reform is expected to boost HSBC's turnover, as the stock's minimum trading unit changes. [Are HSBC shares set for a turnover bump?](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3360270/are-hsbc-shares-set-turnover-bump-owing-hong-kongs-board-lot-reform)
- **Housing Market Rebound Unease:** Hong Kong's housing rebound may be self-limiting as rising prices erode affordability. [Does Hong Kong’s housing market rebound need local owners to sustain it?](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3360211/does-hong-kongs-housing-market-rebound-need-local-owners-sustain-it)

**Signal:** China's hard-tech rally remains a bright spot for foreign investors, but domestic A-shares and Hong Kong property face headwinds; the upcoming Shein IPO and yuan global push will be key tests of market confidence.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
**概览**：社区讨论聚焦三大主题——地缘冲突对商品期货的即时冲击、中际旭创紧急辟谣“小作文”、以及上市公司半年度业绩预告中的亮点。散户情绪在避险与题材间快速切换。

- **霍尔木兹海峡关闭引爆化工期货**：美伊开打消息传出后，合成橡胶暴涨超3%，化工板块集体沸腾。社区用户积极讨论“期股联动”策略，警惕事件驱动行情一日游。 [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBnZXFqT3BPWEw5RmgwRm9oZnhRWmtVRDRjcUhhZ1VjUVRlQjJJeFV5azNUeVpSRWJGUHFDcDhuWmRPM1dXMEFDc0c2dTloOHA1OF9IOFFlMThJRkhMbVE)
- **中际旭创紧急澄清多条“小作文”**：作为融资买入额78亿元居首的明星股，公司出面否认市场传闻，反映高位股在信息不对称下的剧烈波动。 [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5mcm5QREFWZ1FabzlpcnRjNS0xRUEyMHJOQ3hhTzhZbWpRcEFNRG9Kb2xSMEFWbFRXQVpPU2NNVndMal9rQW5ub3pNempnS0dsZDdXclNsVGRQSTlfX3VQMExn)
- **宏桥控股涨停**：预计上半年盈利150亿-160亿元，成为业绩预增概念的代表。社区讨论中顺周期板块的景气度成为热点。 [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5SaExIM29hRm9ZSkpUVUoyaHFjX0tIel9jeXUyeHViMDhaSU5PcVdkczF0UGFYcWRDcmNaUDA2Q0MxRzhLdm5hY2tkSzFYSlNQNGo3czRlbUZldVdmRmYtNzNR)
- **长安汽车300万辆目标承压**：上半年销量仅完成三成，下半年月销需暴涨80%才能达标，引发社区对汽车行业竞争烈度的讨论。 [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9rTFl1UmZsNldfUU8tdGZxeWVKdU9oWE5TaHZBTExxSEJ4eVpSZjFzdXpBd3Z4RHZ0R3FyS2tab0hUWFR0RGxTVG9HSGhuek1yaGxZRy1OMlhBekNaMlJ6cWpB)

**收束判断**：社区情绪呈现“事件驱动+业绩验证”双线并行，地缘冲突短期主导题材炒作，但临近中报窗口，业绩确定性强的大盘股更可能获得资金持续关注。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investors are actively digesting a mix of earnings forecasts, geopolitical commodity spikes, and clarifications on market rumors. Key themes include record-high profit guidance from 宏桥控股, urgent denials of 'small essays' by 中际旭创, and a surge in synthetic rubber prices following the Hormuz Strait closure scare. The broader A-share market saw heavy financing buying, with 中际旭创 leading daily inflows.

- **宏桥控股 Surges on Profit Guidance:** Shares hit the daily limit after the company forecast H1 profit of RMB 15-16 billion, signaling strong aluminum demand. [宏桥控股涨停 预计上半年盈利150亿元至160亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5SaExIM29hRm9ZSkpUVUoyaHFjX0tIel9jeXUyeHViMDhaSU5PcVdkczF0UGFYcWRDcmNaUDA2Q0MxRzhLdm5hY2tkSzFYSlNQNGo3czRlbUZldVdmRmYtNzNR)
- **中际旭创 Denies Market Rumors:** The optical module maker issued an emergency clarification against multiple 'small essays' circulating online, amid high financing activity (RMB 7.843 billion in margin buys on July 10). [中际旭创，紧急澄清多条“小作文”！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5mcm5QREFWZ1FabzlpcnRjNS0xRUEyMHJOQ3hhTzhZbWpRcEFNRG9Kb2xSMEFWbFRXQVpPU2NNVndMal9rQW5ub3pNempnS0dsZDdXclNsVGRQSTlfX3VQMExn); [7月10日579股获融资买入超亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5HQTdPa2lUbFdORjdFaTJqVVJ6RnRSdjl6SlpsQ2s1VUJJTDNmZTBmalJNM1N3U2RXN3V3a2gzcVVJT3N1c2ZpXzltMFdNMWFfX0xYbno2UG90VG90WHc)
- **Commodity Play on Geopolitical Risk:** Synthetic rubber surged over 3% as fears of Hormuz Strait closure boosted chemical futures, with the community flagging the '期股联动' (futures-equity linkage). [【期股联动】美伊开打霍尔木兹海峡关闭！合成橡胶暴涨超3%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBnZXFqT3BPWEw5RmgwRm9oZnhRWmtVRDRjcUhhZ1VjUVRlQjJJeFV5azNUeVpSRWJGUHFDcDhuWmRPM1dXMEFDc0c2dTloOHA1OF9IOFFlMThJRkhMbVE)
- **长安汽车 Target Worries:** With only 30% of its 3.3 million-unit annual target achieved by mid-year, the company would need an 80% monthly sales surge in H2 to meet the goal. [330万辆目标进度仅三成，长安汽车下半年月销需暴涨80%才能达标？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9rTFl1UmZsNldfUU8tdGZxeWVKdU9oWE5TaHZBTExxSEJ4eVpSZjFzdXpBd3Z4RHZ0R3FyS2tab0hUWFR0RGxTVG9HSGhuek1yaGxZRy1OMlhBekNaMlJ6cWpB)
- **Tech & Innovation Awards:** Haier Air Conditioning won a National Science and Technology Progress Award, while 泰晶科技 co-organized a frequency components conference. [海尔空调再夺国家科技进步奖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBZZGhlOHdlRzBESmRGZHBGX0xpNnVIUU4xSnBZaU53bUthTjJ3R29qeGtua0J2UlNoTm1lN1c2M2twR0VOQnQwTWlaMnB1ejBYWDFMWG5WSmMzYmxGSUpnMm9R); [泰晶科技携手2026中国频率元器件大会](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBuaTV4YmFmN1dCWERUbHcxTV9MMGt1UExyUEl4bUJsekVRYzZnYTh3UGcyLUUtNTg2OF9QdmRHcTItVDVON2dONklxMDFBZk41dUxwbms2bUVKYTA4azd1cVJR)

**Signal:** Retail investor attention is split between chasing high-probability earnings stories (宏桥控股), managing rumor risk (中际旭创), and trading geopolitical commodities; a cautious approach is warranted given A-share market weakness.

欧美.zh: 美伊冲突在24小时内急剧恶化。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队宣布已打击科威特、约旦、巴林境内美军基地，作为对美军新一轮空袭伊朗港口城市（阿巴斯港、锡里克、贾斯克及格什姆岛）的回应。此前6月达成的停火协议已名存实亡，[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cevlr112pmgo)与[半岛电视台](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/13/iran-war-live-us-bombs-iranian-cities-again-as-hormuz-standoff-intensifies)互证攻击规模。此外，美国参议员林赛·格雷厄姆因突发心脏病去世，[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgj25j6nmeo)指出其作为特朗普核心盟友的消失将重塑共和党外交政策路线；麦康奈尔因跌倒并发肺炎继续缺勤。欧洲野火蔓延至巴黎地区，系首次从南部调派灭火飞机北上，[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clye4z168edo)称此为气候异常信号。曼谷酒吧火灾伤亡惨重，消防员抵达时现场仍有顾客穿越火海逃生。整体来看，地缘冲突与气候灾害正以前所未有的频率交叠，欧美社会安全网面临双重压力。
欧美.en:
The desk covers major international developments reported by Western outlets, with the US-Iran conflict taking center stage. The crisis deepened as Iran struck US bases in three Gulf states after American bombings hit Iranian port cities. Meanwhile, the sudden death of Senator Lindsey Graham and Mitch McConnell’s health absence reshape US politics. Europe faces environmental emergencies: wildfires near Paris prompted an unprecedented deployment of firefighting planes, and a British couple was badly burned in Spanish blazes.

- **US-Iran strikes and retaliation**: The US launched a new wave of strikes 'aimed at degrading Iran's military,' hours after Iran attacked bases in Kuwait, Jordan, and Bahrain. The conflict threatens to disrupt Strait of Hormuz shipping. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cevlr112pmgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/12/us-launches-new-wave-of-strikes-against-iran-aimed-at-degrading-military?traffic_source=rss))
- **Lindsey Graham dies at 71**: The South Carolina senator and Trump ally passed away from a 'brief and sudden illness.' His obituary notes his political evolution from Trump critic to loyalist. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvgj25j6nmeo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC analysis](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyrdn216k2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Mitch McConnell remains out after fall and pneumonia**: The veteran Republican leader said he will not return 'quite yet,' amid weeks of speculation about his health. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvge2nd611zo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Paris wildfires trigger rare aerial response**: Firefighting planes were sent from the south for the first time to combat blazes of 'exceptional scale' near the capital. In Spain, a British couple with 40% burns was rescued from a ravine. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clye4z168edo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2x7441762o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Bangkok bar fire kills 27**: While geographically outside the West, the story was covered widely by US/European media. The fire in Chatuchak district left 63 injured, many critically. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c24yev53q06o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/13/at-least-27-dead-as-fire-engulfs-popular-bangkok-pub-near-chatuchak-market?traffic_source=rss))

This desk signals a volatile geopolitical landscape with concurrent security and climate emergencies demanding attention.

知乎社区动态.zh: 知乎（02390.HK）在7月10日继续执行股份回购计划，以13.34万美元回购12.24万股，这是自今年4月以来多次公开市场操作的最新一次。[中金在线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1BTkdRSGdiVUgxalZEd29GdklYS1Z4R1dIRGh4c09jQ3ZOU3o0U2tOWTBkWkR2aWpTeGp6eXlPZ1NOdnBxVWRKd0tFWjBScjY5V29vNkhTNlkwY2c5TkR5bVlqUC04M3l0MHJBWg)和[Moomoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE9NcVRFZ1dXU2ZQYUhMa1doQ3N6OUI5VjdlUTZ0MEJ5NUpKOTVnRGxDNEVDRUwzZzZsRU4xTVFXU3JhMTdVNnhlQ0FZM3lOM0EyQjM0UVFSWU1XZw)均报道了回购细节，金额与数量与此前节奏一致。回购行为本身未引发市场明显波动，社区内讨论热度有限。考虑到公司股价长期承压，回购更多是管理层稳定信心的防御性动作，而非增长信号。预计短期内知乎仍将维持低量回购，对整体财务影响可忽略。
知乎社区动态.en:
The Zhihu community desk shows three related items all concerning the company's stock buyback activity. Between April and July 2026, Zhihu-W (02390.HK) has been repurchasing shares, with the latest transactions on July 10 totaling approximately $13.34 million for 122,400 shares. This repurchase program may signal management’s confidence or an attempt to stabilize the stock price.

- **Zhihu repurchases shares multiple times**: The company executed buybacks from April to July, with the most recent on July 10 costing $13.34 million. ([中金在线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1BTkdRSGdiVUgxalZEd29GdklYS1Z4R1dIRGh4c09jQ3ZOU3o0U2tOWTBkWkR2aWpTeGp6eXlPZ1NOdnBxVWRKd0tFWjBScjY5V29vNkhTNlkwY2c5TkR5bVlqUC04M3l0MHJBWg), [Moomoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE9NcVRFZ1dXU2ZQYUhMa1doQ3N6OUI5VjdlUTZ0MEJ5NUpKOTVnRGxDNEVDRUwzZzZsRU4xTVFXU3JhMTdVNnhlQ0FZM3lOM0EyQjM0UVFSWU1XZw))
- **Consistent buyback pattern**: The frequency suggests a strategic move to return capital or support the share price in a challenging market environment. ([中金在线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTFA5bm9EUnJMRmw1ck9LeXhwSGQyeDVlTHJmcjdMQ2pQaXdNTFkzOFBHLTVLY1FZT0lwaDBGRjNJOEFWN0piWUhxME5SdkhOWjFYc1hNWmFpTkhHTmJOMWNPNkVMN20yWURCaG5XLQ))

Investors should watch whether the buyback pace continues and if it has any material impact on the stock's valuation.

日韩.zh: 日韩区域呈现安全与民生双线交织。韩国海军一名巡逻士兵失踪后被发现死于朝韩海上边界附近，[南华早报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxOejFQVU1ON0xqNkVUc3hlSUM2cm5xdWhVaGtQTTQzbXhnMVJxc1hkSHViWjRPNTk4NURib2h5dFdieTFqVkhDSUZwbUkwbWZiMEpwYWpkSmRwYWZvNUo3b2dRVHpJQ0hsY0FHRFhrb3JfNDZ6UkpQU0ZEWnRmY3VDZzgweWdhVUczZC1hLXlJWUFHZkl2S2xuYVdoNzA2NnVOamR2dVBxTGdaZ2FFSVMtN1E3Zm5hbkFmVjhNTEhNQjg0a0luVjVCRTJn)报道暗示可能与朝方有关联，加剧半岛紧张。与此同时，特朗普政府推动日韩加强防务协调，[东亚论坛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOVkV2VFlKRXNSM0dWSDl6dGY4dVdPejFxdXVnX2ZLQXVuOTJDLWpVSXFlaUlaWW5LYmg1X2FaYk5GeHVGbG5SSE8wcF9KQUZhMkhRSTRmSFdwbzFjZXJnRkJ4YlFxeG1IOFoyS3VTM3V2aVpOOW5kMjRqbEFNWlV1eEIwMktGSmF1X2NQV2o0b1NfWHZxNVNObGZiMmRHdw)称此举旨在应对区域安全风险。日本宠物经济迎爆发点，[半岛电视台](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/13/japans-pet-care-industry-booms-as-fur-babies-outnumber-infants?traffic_source=rss)指出“毛孩子”数量首超婴儿，婴儿用品企业转向宠物市场。韩国气象厅发布首个热浪紧急警告，[韩国先驱报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE42c1l3cGtHZV9oRGJDOFdvWWdvWkpHdC1yNmI4OXBTR283UC05bXFNVkFtT2MySW1ZeWxuS0NpN01nSEVSOGY1QW1RbWR3NXlUT042NHFkNA)称东南部地区受影响。此外，日本成功试飞可重复使用火箭，标志太空技术新突破。日韩之间的航空与消费联系进一步深化，Eastar Jet扩增福冈至首尔每日四班往返，越南成为访韩长期游客最大来源国。整体看，日韩在防务与经济上同步加速整合，但内部社会风险（高温、少子化）未减。
日韩.en:
This desk covers a mix of economic, security, and social developments in Japan and Korea. A South Korean sailor missing on patrol was found dead near the North Korea sea border, raising military tensions. Japan’s pet care industry is booming as pets outnumber infants, while a heat wave emergency was issued in southeastern Korea. On the positive side, Japan successfully launched and landed a reusable rocket, and Eastar Jet is expanding Fukuoka-Seoul flights. Geopolitical alignment between Tokyo and Seoul under Trump is noted.

- **South Korean sailor found dead near NLL**: The missing patrolman's body was discovered near the Northern Limit Line, potentially escalating tensions with North Korea. Details on cause remain unclear. ([SCMP](https://news.google.))
- **Japan's pet industry overtakes baby market**: With pets outnumbering infants, baby product manufacturers are pivoting to pet care, reflecting deep demographic shifts. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/13/japans-pet-care-industry-booms-as-fur-babies-outnumber-infants?traffic_source=rss))
- **Korea issues first heat wave emergency**: The Korea Meteorological Administration warned of dangerously high temperatures in the southeastern region, affecting public health and energy demand. ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE42c1l3cGtHZV9oRGJDOFdvWWdvWkpHdC1yNmI4OXBTR283UC05bXFNVkFtT2MySW1ZeWxuS0NpN01nSEVSOGY1QW1RbWR3NXlUT042NHFkNA))
- **Japan launches reusable rocket successfully**: The milestone reduces launch costs and boosts Japan’s space ambitions. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQZjE3QW9TMGZSSU8wWkZOZXRzRzE3X3FZUm51Qk8xUFk1MXNvckt5MXdoaFF2dFFUdFdKbEMxRl9NWDU3cXlsSHduVjgyOE9Kc0h2WEppdHpCVWJja1pucDF0cGI3VUZWQnFpUUZfbzh5OHdsT1B1X3hLZVA2bkpsa1V2czhITnFXdVJPbHotYXBNRkNuZ0hDaldxemN2TkFkb2JxMFhn))
- **Trump drives closer Tokyo-Seoul alignment**: An analysis notes that US policy is pushing Japan and South Korea to cooperate more tightly on defense and trade. ([East Asia Forum](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOVkV2VFlKRXNSM0dWSDl6dGY4dVdPejFxdXVnX2ZLQXVuOTJDLWpVSXFlaUlaWW5LYmg1X2FaYk5GeHVGbG5SSE8wcF9KQUZhMkhRSTRmSFdwbzFjZXJnRkJ4YlFxeG1IOFoyS3VTM3V2aVpOOW5kMjRqbEFNWlV1eEIwMktGSmF1X2NQV2o0b1NfWHZxNVNObGZiMmRHdw))

This desk highlights a region balancing security risks (NLL incident, heat wave) with technological and economic progress.

中国.zh: 超强台风登陆浙江，近200万人紧急转移，[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo)报道学校停课、交通停运，这是本年度中国遭遇的最强气象灾害之一。社会层面，《社会保障绿皮书（2026）》在西安发布，[手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1PWWhzWUFvc3pUVDI0bnZHSFpwWXZaRzdhWDR2cTZNeHZFazNVRnVwQllja0RyQ05QQnphaUlmRVp6LXJRZVJ0QnFadUoySktTZFRJa2dENDM1TGJmVWV5ZjBn)披露了系统改革方向。特殊教育立法学术研讨会在京召开，[中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE43VFQ2aHJyLXg2dWVPSmpIQkxVRXBzVndncXJraGxiSmxscTBFSFdkTko2cF96VDRGdHNJQUxwVTlId0RoRmxVTGJqczRidlJ1MEZpYmxfZC1MZGh2LWFvcHVDQ25sWm9uM3pj)报道进展，或预示政策补短板。基层正能量故事持续：一名党员10年送出27万份爱心早餐，[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQalVsWmN3c01vZjNaQkJkWHJUVDlKMmd6c3loUkFKQUxETmt0V1k2VnJUWnltYUM1Um8tYVZLOXhHZjZJODk0d21sOWhkZXJCaGdrdXd6UXdFZmV4TjBFbXd4ZDVaa0hCODI0akFOX1VTOEhpWjdnSkRVOGVJaDlvVklfeFBzZFVLZDVr)关注。全国层面，医疗队援外、台湾大学生实习、开源AI边会等活动显示中国在多领域保持开放姿态。总体看，中国社会在应对自然灾害的同时，稳步推进立法与民生保障，但老外来华医疗旅游话题引发争议，[风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9WeTJSVE9YdTVpQVVTMV9tMjJYTVVfNU9ESXpwWkpwU0JOMlQwU00yNUV4YUxjVGZTRGlQMHRzVzE2QW9tSzNnRlVGVWtKdmhZRWlOSkxqbF85Wms)讨论分歧，折射社会对开放政策的复杂心态。
中国.en:
China desk reports focus on domestic policy, disaster response, and international medical cooperation. A powerful typhoon forced the evacuation of nearly 2 million people in Zhejiang — the dominant story. Other items include the release of a social security report in Xi'an, a special education law symposium, and medical teams serving in Kiribati and Equatorial Guinea. Grassroots stories like a decade-long free breakfast initiative and a university survey program also feature.

- **Typhoon forces 2 million evacuations in Zhejiang**: Schools closed, transport halted, and outdoor activities suspended as a powerful storm made landfall. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdxd3wkp2rzo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Social Security Green Paper published in Xi'an**: The report outlines China's social security development in 2026, likely informing policy adjustments. ([手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1PWWhzWUFvc3pUVDI0bnZHSFpwWXZaRzdhWDR2cTZNeHZFazNVRnVwQllja0RyQ05QQnphaUlmRVp6LXJRZVJ0QnFadUoySktTZFRJa2dENDM1TGJmVWV5ZjBn))
- **Special education law symposium held in Beijing**: Academic discussion on advancing legislation for special education indicates potential policy moves. ([中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE43VFQ2aHJyLXg2dWVPSmpIQkxVRXBzVndncXJraGxiSmxscTBFSFdkTko2cF96VDRGdHNJQUxwVTlId0RoRmxVTGJqczRidlJ1MEZpYmxfZC1MZGh2LWFvcHVDQ25sWm9uM3pj))
- **Chinese medical team conducts free clinic in Kiribati**: The 5th team continues outreach in outer islands, reflecting soft power efforts. ([中国网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBvdWI4WWZxY2tadXhQSHdhdVlERk14T21hYzJwdUY5RDVvWkNlVEluemthWTVRZjlURXJWNThYQ2R4Z0hEUzRwdHlCS0NMaDFXeUpyWUxQMjFUX282VXI0N2dEX3N6T19Ib1JN))
- **Academic ethics review committee established at Chinese Academy of Social Sciences**: A step toward regulating research integrity. ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPNTZDQUdIXzZYUUtzRzFhVlRybGZCX0tfN1llQmRhc0xaS3JQQ0VJQWFKLXExSjZwLUI4YzNoVEFQVnRTTVVMbm1kZzhIV0xCRFVEYzViWUo3Z1VDQlZ3eVVaTXRVY3NsbXh5Q0pQUzd5SWUwRl82U25iLXZxXzZvdV9pWQ))

This desk shows China balancing crisis management (typhoon) with long-term governance and international engagement.

国际安全.zh:
**概览**：美伊在霍尔木兹海峡的军事互殴成为国际安全头号焦点，双方已完成多轮打击，美国中央司令部称最新波次瞄准伊朗防空与导弹能力。同时，中国J-16战机挂载能力引发技术关注，台湾方面成立新反舰导弹单位也值得留意。

- [伊朗向海湾国家发起攻击，美军发动数月来最大规模空袭](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxORUNEd2J3SmxCOVdjblNITm5abTREZkJaOXZIRzFNTWFLaTV4aTBsZnB0MXllclhjQzRZb0ppYWZObmIzeXJ5SkNNNU1QalZPRTZEdFo4Qm1tMVFzSi10YXN4aVMxU2gyOXhhTFE5RE9DUVJLT3JPLXV6OVJ0S3FrTm9jX25HUVJFSmNDZXE4eDZGZ3RVemc4enlVUlFncDh4MXZLUUdWVVpVazc2) —— 伊朗攻击海湾国家为回击美方制裁与军事施压，战火已从波斯湾蔓延至阿拉伯半岛。
- [美伊为霍尔木兹海峡控制权交手，全球能源动脉告急](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPcVpldGkwZktsUlRGYlRtUnlpM2Y1UF9iX0lKWmdxczBjMXl6cHhsckZ5YTZ5OVNjdWdkSzg3N3lTN21pNkNQTWVSS0NlZTlWbzBkSEUxekpYMXhLOGdpbFRRQ0FUemY3TTk2ZVByUTJLVzJhenBDQXJHOGt5TVhqT2J5RWtfeWRiRWNxdWh6TDhwdXQ5S0E) —— 雅虎与WSJ均指出海峡通行量虽较5月有所回升（从233次增至576次），但仍远低于去年同期的3131次，航运保险与绕行成本高企。
- [台湾海军组建配备美制鱼叉导弹的海岸打击指挥部](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNT0dHaDdkdDNENVhKMG5qU0lFSVl0N2U3MHAzNzdPTEk5UVVPaFEteFI2dVpPWHc1cXJhNUpPaHlTdlIyRVZ3bkdBMGZ5NXVqTVJ1RWJORldCU0dlOG1LUE9nbTI2aXJPOENzYVZleDlob3RLZFF1NmoyOWJaZFlHMGRqbG9rdw) —— 军事观察杂志分析，此举意在强化反舰能力，应对解放军可能的两栖攻击。

**收束判断**：美伊冲突有演变为长期消耗战的趋势，霍尔木兹海峡的“常态化”高风险将对全球能源市场产生持续冲击，各国海军在波斯湾的护航与对峙压力剧增。
国际安全.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a dramatic escalation between the United States and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz. Multiple waves of U.S. strikes targeted Iranian air defenses and missile capabilities, while Iran retaliated with attacks on Gulf states. The conflict has disrupted one of the world's most critical energy chokepoints, with transits still dramatically below normal. Meanwhile, Ukraine's claims of striking Russian ships in the Sea of Azov and China's J-16 'Beast Mode' display add to the global security landscape.

- The U.S. and Iran traded new rounds of strikes, with CENTCOM completing a wave focusing on Iranian air defenses and missiles ([The Jerusalem Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE1FYzFnZjdXWWlwZ0JBc3NwU3ZWNk9EOElWVy1YZ1NtVkVmQUZiOG10UzZ0UklWR29oTF9TMC16a3VrbENkR2tIUUJVclBGN1JReGVmRVhlMGpKWmhm)). Iran launched attacks on Gulf states as U.S. strikes escalated ([The Washington Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxORUNEd2J3SmxCOVdjblNITm5abTREZkJaOXZIRzFNTWFLaTV4aTBsZnB0MXllclhjQzRZb0ppYWZObmIzeXJ5SkNNNU1QalZPRTZEdFo4Qm1tMVFzSi10YXN4aVMxU2gyOXhhTFE5RE9DUVJLT3JPLXV6OVJ0S3FrTm9jX25HUVJFSmNDZXE4eDZGZ3RVemc4enlVUlFncDh4MXZLUUdWVVpVazc2)).
- The Strait of Hormuz remains the epicenter, with both sides vying for control. Attacks have targeted the waterway critical to global energy supplies ([Yahoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPcVpldGkwZktsUlRGYlRtUnlpM2Y1UF9iX0lKWmdxczBjMXl6cHhsckZ5YTZ5OVNjdWdkSzg3N3lTN21pNkNQTWVSS0NlZTlWbzBkSEUxekpYMXhLOGdpbFRRQ0FUemY3TTk2ZVByUTJLVzJhenBDQXJHOGt5TVhqT2J5RWtfeWRiRWNxdWh6TDhwdXQ5S0E)).
- Ukraine claims it struck scores of Russian ships in the Sea of Azov, targeting oil tankers ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/ukraine-claims-scores-of-russian-ships-struck-in-sea-of-azov)), adding a new dimension to the conflict.
- China's J-16 fighter showcased a 'Beast Mode' loadout, highlighting its growing strike capabilities ([The Times of India](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_)).
- A separate article noted the US Air Force is set for a $240 million upgrade as Trump leaves office ([Simple Flying](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBxcnJKRlhoMkpWZWpVdkw1VHV6bUZoNElISW85bnlYX0hTb2xpSnBMenpaMHdCRHZYY21KcUR0aEljT21xZzJEeVg1R0ZCZXZmWEFCU3hnZXdZTkI5eXd6V3VDTHROX1JGcURiUlRZYmlMNEN4a1hoblZWMGdwUQ)).

**Signal:** The U.S.-Iran standoff shows no sign of de-escalation; further strikes on both sides are expected to continue, with potential for broader regional involvement.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览**：乌克兰与俄罗斯在亚速海的海上冲突出现新形态，乌克兰声称以远程无人机击中多艘俄方油轮，意在打击俄能源经济并切断克里米亚补给线。中东战局则分流了西方对乌克兰的关注，欧盟外长会议与北约峰会均需同时处理两场冲突。

- [乌克兰宣称在亚速海击中“一大批”俄方船舶](https://www.twz.com/news-features/ukraine-claims-scores-of-russian-ships-struck-in-sea-of-azov) —— 战争地带报道，此次攻击主要针对运输燃料的油轮，俄国内能源价格与战争供应已受影响。与此印证的是[俄方证实油轮被击中](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNbVFDd21ZLUFoVmd4dWVjUmFaSGZ0eFc2QVRxMVNreWNoS2NLNjhYcWRpWmlBMlRrVl9nWXJkQ1FaZnlBbHRJRk9KTkNERjZSOW9ZUkNkbFl3VzJONkhjbm5NVU92WkUzM3VKQWVkT2dkTWVXRVd5NnRKUFVFZEdORGxwNzd4QzZrSXJTb1k1NG1rUDB2dW5rRUpSWGNfUQ)。
- [中东冲突正转移西方对乌克兰的注意力](https://news.google.) —— 俄军事媒体和RTÉ均指出，欧盟外长会议和土耳其内阁讨论中，乌克兰议题被中东危机挤占。
- [乌克兰前线地区逼近IPC第3级粮食安全危机](https://news.google.) —— ReliefWeb发布的预报显示，靠近前线的地区在2027年1月前将持续处于危机状态。

**收束判断**：乌克兰在海上的不对称打击取得一定效果，但无法根本改变地面战线；西方战略资源被迫两线分散，乌克兰军援面临不确定性。粮食危机则成为冲突的长期次生灾害。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape is marked by the ongoing U.S.-Iran escalation drawing Western attention away from Ukraine, while Russia's war in Ukraine continues to see new strikes on its maritime assets. Food security in Ukraine is deteriorating near frontlines, and diplomatic efforts (EU, NATO, Turkey) are trying to manage both theatres. A rare humanitarian note comes from the Pope urging dialogue.

- The Middle East conflict is diverting Western focus and resources from Ukraine, as noted by Russian military analysis ([Военное дело](https://news.google.)). This could create an opportunity for Russian advances.
- Ukraine claims to have struck scores of Russian ships in the Sea of Azov, with Russia confirming a tanker was hit ([The Moscow Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNbVFDd21ZLUFoVmd4dWVjUmFaSGZ0eFc2QVRxMVNreWNoS2NLNjhYcWRpWmlBMlRrVl9nWXJkQ1FaZnlBbHRJRk9KTkNERjZSOW9ZUkNkbFl3VzJONkhjbm5NVU92WkUzM3VKQWVkT2dkTWVXRVd5NnRKUFVFZEdORGxwNzd4QzZrSXJTb1k1NG1rUDB2dW5rRUpSWGNfUQ)). This signals Ukraine's growing ability to strike Russian economic assets.
- Ukraine's food security outlook warns of Crisis (IPC Phase 3) outcomes in frontline areas from June 2026 to January 2027 ([ReliefWeb](https://news.google.)).
- Pope Francis called for the winds of war not to extinguish hope and for a return to dialogue ([Vatican News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOZWp1Ri10dmFPb2J5SlQ3aGFQN1E0QVNGOEdON3hXVlBfRW1iZklKYTdsMTZfckk5T0xIVG1PU2JLODdMTzE1R0lhSjEzWTVmY3ZmUXplc185T2IxTUQ4MUFlZ2RidEd3ZmNDbkdpdkNSNG1tZ0Zfejc4N3pidE5rNjdCRWlJeHFFOVVFQ1lSQjRaaEtwdGllOFpvTHM3eTY2clRCSE91d0c5Z2EwS1lONVgxTWc)).
- EU foreign ministers and Turkey's cabinet are separately scheduled to discuss Ukraine, NATO, and Middle East crises ([RTE.ie](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPcHRfajZKSzZMc1IydHgtX3FwY1RJZjZwVldoR0hHNTI5ckh5NUhMLXlnSUdadi1xaWR0R29YWi13YTNwc2ozM2EzM2VQaW1hUHJvLW9wNXRlU3dJYVZuZjBYaTVzazdBYklLbUk3N3NlbWJRQ0V6cURuTEFrZktOWWY2WXd4QQ), [Report.az](https://news.google.)).

**Signal:** The risk of a two-front crisis is real; if the U.S.-Iran conflict deepens, Ukraine could face reduced support, potentially altering the battlefield balance.

中国军情.zh:
**概览**：南海仲裁案十周年之际，美、日、澳、菲等14国发表联合声明，指称中国“南海扩张缺乏法律依据”。中国外交部与官媒密集反击，称该声明是“14国想恐吓谁”，并重申不承认仲裁裁决。与此同时，解放军披露水下发射战略导弹信息及J-16重载挂载，展示拒止能力。

- [日美等14国就南海仲裁案裁决发表联合声明](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9nTDRmcGozRmZwODZyNW1Rb2dEV0lBcy12NDk3NExkQ2NyVXliSlVYNlRUOF9peTVpbnZUX0ZJTVRmemMxR2V2dnlSdE1sYnpVQVBBOGloZw) —— 共同社报道，声明正值7月12日裁决十周年，呼吁中国停止“军事化”和“胁迫性行为”。
- [中国驻欧盟使团和外交部严词回应：日本无资格说三道四，中国不信邪](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNaHRYVXpqYWhibEpLeldRQVF2ZHRCNEk5YjhocTcwQ19ITk9peDF3VnJLcWxxQXVkRG5jcU9FQnUtYmxwYkRhV1podDZDMnJVeUt6TWoxVGZ0S24xYU9qdmlPR083RGdST2pJQklsNDZpSEZ5VVpTYzBhTnF3dnNOal9oTlFfZ0JvdXpJ) —— 香港电台报道，中方谴责声明破坏地区稳定。环球时报社评称“14国声明想恐吓谁？中国人民不信邪也不怕邪”。
- [中国海军水下发射战略导弹信息量巨大](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9ZeTBSQlRnY095SWpTU1BvdFRzTFRnX2x3aEh0ZGFBVTNqV1pBcW0yZzRCczllR0I0N3VEOW05V3lNQlF5WDlzSlBFaVJha3NQbWdRcGZyemZNRGs) —— 风闻评论称此次发射意在强化海基核威慑，回应外部军事压力。
- [解放军J-16挂载“野兽模式”引印媒关注](https://news.google.com/rticles/CBMi-_) —— 印度时报解读为针对航母和基地的饱和打击能力。

**收束判断**：南海仲裁案声明更多是政治姿态，但中国在军力展示上（重型挂载、水下导弹）做出实质回应，表明不会因外交压力而改变行动。未来南海摩擦可能因“灰色地带”行动增加而升高。
中国军情.en:
China's military posture in the South China Sea and its growing air power dominated this desk. The tenth anniversary of the 2016 South China Sea arbitration ruling saw 14 nations, led by Japan and the U.S., issue a joint statement declaring China's claims legally baseless. China dismissed the statement as a 'farce' and accused Japan of having no standing. Meanwhile, a Chinese submarine-launched ballistic missile test was flagged as a significant signal, and the J-16 'Beast Mode' display reinforced Beijing's conventional deterrence.

- Japan, the U.S., and 12 other nations issued a joint statement on the anniversary of the South China Sea arbitration ruling, stating China's expansion has no legal basis ([RFI](https://news.google.)). China fired back, calling the move an attempt to intimidate ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNbTQtbG1uSFBiNXVCSmxDMnpZcXlNRVJRVnNEZm54MGZjRnNIdHF0ellRTU5ob1VhOUlNeXVLcnBhSTZwRGVscW93LXIycEg3OGFXUTBsekVnb1JySzludldMMkdvYWZHXzRqMkVyWVZoYmhXOXhDeTdVSkliNEowdHlER01CSkI2NVJ3)).
- A Chinese article described the submarine-launched strategic missile test as 'explosive' in its implications, signaling Beijing's undersea nuclear deterrence ([风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9ZeTBSQlRnY095SWpTU1BvdFRzTFRnX2x3aEh0ZGFBVTNqV1pBcW0yZzRCczllR0I0N3VEOW05V3lNQlF5WDlzSlBFaVJha3NQbWdRcGZyemZNRGs)).
- The J-16 fighter's heaviest-ever missile loadout (dubbed 'Beast Mode') was highlighted by Indian media, noting its potential for air-to-ground strikes ([The Times of India](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-_)).
- China's foreign ministry separately rebuked Japan for commenting on South China Sea sovereignty, reiterating its firm stance ([香港電台](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNaHRYVXpqYWhibEpLeldRQVF2ZHRCNEk5YjhocTcwQ19ITk9peDF3VnJLcWxxQXVkRG5jcU9FQnUtYmxwYkRhV1podDZDMnJVeUt6TWoxVGZ0S24xYU9qdmlPR083RGdST2pJQklsNDZpSEZ5VVpTYzBhTnF3dnNOal9oTlFfZ0JvdXpJ)).
- The Republic of China (Taiwan) Navy formed a new coastal combat command armed with U.S. Harpoon missiles, marking a shift in its defensive posture ([Military Watch Magazine](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNT0dHaDdkdDNENVhKMG5qU0lFSVl0N2U3MHAzNzdPTEk5UVVPaFEteFI2dVpPWHc1cXJhNUpPaHlTdlIyRVZ3bkdBMGZ5NXVqTVJ1RWJORldCU0dlOG1LUE9nbTI2aXJPOENzYVZleDlob3RLZFF1NmoyOWJaZFlHMGRqbG9rdw)).

**Signal:** The South China Sea diplomatic war is intensifying; expect China to conduct military exercises in response to the 14-nation statement, potentially increasing risk of incidents with regional navies.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览**：全球海军力量建设加速：美空军大幅增产LRASM/JASSM，欧洲启动高超音速拦截器HYDIS项目，德国海军签约激光武器部署时间表，均反映大国竞争背景下反介入/区域拒止与反制手段的竞赛。霍尔木兹海峡航运虽短期反弹但风险依旧，美海军新政策限制医疗刮脸豁免也折射出战备从严趋势。

- [美空军LRASM和JASSM产量将翻三倍，采购超1.1万枚](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/) —— 海军新闻称，合同目标明确针对未来高强度冲突中的弹药消耗储备，尤其瞄准西太平洋与中东方向。
- [欧盟签署HYDIS高超音速拦截器概念阶段拨款](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/eu-signs-grant-for-mbda-led-hydis-hypersonic-interceptor-project/) —— MBDA主导的“天鹰座”拦截器完成最终概念评审，进入3年开发期，回应中俄高超音速武器威胁。
- [德国海军计划2029年前列装MBDA与莱茵金属联合激光武器](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-navy-to-deploy-new-mbda-and-rheinmetall-laser-weapon-by-2029/) —— 德国BAAINBw签署合同，预期用于近程反无人机及反舰导弹防御。
- [霍尔木兹海峡6月通行量较5月翻倍仍远低于往年，冲突风险持续](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks) —— USNI新闻援引Lloyd's List Intelligence数据，6月576次通行对比5月233次，但同比下降82%。

**收束判断**：全球海军正同步进入“技术与弹药储备”竞赛期，反舰导弹与拦截器产能成关键变量。霍尔木兹海峡的脆弱性凸显海军能源安全角色的紧迫性，而德国激光武器等新概念装备的部署时间表表明，欧洲也在加速适应无人化与高超威胁。
海军与印太.en:
Naval and Indo-Pacific developments cover three main threads: the ongoing Strait of Hormuz crisis and its impact on shipping, major arms production increases (U.S. LRASM/JASSM, EU hypersonic interceptor), and force modernization (German Navy laser weapon, anti-drone warfare, RIMPAC exercises). The U.S. Navy also issued a new medical shaving waiver policy, while a Congressional report details extended nuclear deterrence. 

- Despite Iranian attacks, Strait of Hormuz transits doubled from May to June 2026 (to 576), but remain a fraction of pre-crisis levels (3,131 in June 2025) ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/hormuz-sees-traffic-bump-despite-ongoing-iranian-attacks)). The shipping industry is adjusting to high-risk operations.
- The U.S. Air Force plans to triple LRASM and JASSM production, with a planned procurement of over 11,000 missiles over five to seven years ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/lrasm-and-jassm-production-to-triple-under-new-us-air-force-contract/)). This dramatically expands the Pentagon's inventory for long-range anti-ship and strike capabilities.
- The EU signed a grant for the MBDA-led HYDIS hypersonic interceptor project, launching a three-year concept phase for the AQUILA interceptor ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/eu-signs-grant-for-mbda-led-hydis-hypersonic-interceptor-project/)). This addresses the growing hypersonic threat.
- The German Navy selected MBDA and Rheinmetall to develop a high-energy laser weapon, with deployment expected by 2029 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-navy-to-deploy-new-mbda-and-rheinmetall-laser-weapon-by-2029/)). This marks a step toward directed-energy naval air defense.
- A report on anti-drone warfare at sea emphasizes the need for AESA radar and hard-kill effectors to counter Tier 2 drone threats ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/anti-drone-warfare-at-sea-matching-sensors-and-effectors-to-the-threat/)).
- RIMPAC 2026 is now in its at-sea phase, with live-firing drills including Canadian frigates ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-july-10-2026)). 
- A Congressional Research Service report on U.S. extended deterrence and regional nuclear capabilities was released, highlighting assurance to over 30 allies ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/10/report-to-congress-on-u-s-extended-deterrence-and-regional-nuclear-capabilities-2)).

**Signal:** The U.S. is massively investing in long-range standoff missiles, while European navies focus on hypersonic and laser defenses—indicating a shift away from short-range systems toward distributed, longer-range engagements in a contested maritime environment.

科技产品.zh:
**概览**：智能戒指Oura Ring 5获评测热捧，但苹果Pencil将因欧盟法规迎来可换电池设计，Xiaomi在美国的“隐形销售”折射出更复杂的市场壁垒。

- Oura Ring 5被The Verge评为[最佳智能戒指](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964386/oura-ring-5-review-smart-ring-wearables)，适合新手，但老用户升级动力不足。同期Engadget解析[Xiaomi为何不在美销售](https://www.engadget.com/2210461/why-xiaomi-not-banned-rarely-sold-usa/)——非禁令所致，而是专利、供应链与品牌认知的复合阻碍。
- [Apple Pencil明年或迎可维修性升级](https://www.engadget.com/2213077/refreshed-apple-pencils-may-arrive-next-year-with-improved-repairability/)，受欧盟法规驱动，可更换电池设计将落地，反映监管正向影响消费电子可持续性。
- [Wired盘点最佳机器人泳池清洁器](https://www.wired.com/story/best-pool-cleaning-robots/)、[STEM玩具](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-stem-toys-for-kids/)等购指南，侧面印证家庭自动化与教育科技消费需求持续扩大。

**判断**：智能穿戴向“减法”进化（Oura），而可维修性正在成为新旗舰标配。
科技产品.en:
The consumer tech world saw updates on Apple's upcoming hardware policies, a definitive smart ring review, and a continued absence of Xiaomi in the US. Key stories highlight regulatory pressures and market dynamics.

- **Apple Pencil Refresh:** Upcoming EU regulations on repairability may force Apple to introduce replaceable batteries in the next Apple Pencil, likely arriving next year ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2213077/refreshed-apple-pencils-may-arrive-next-year-with-improved-repairability/)).
- **Oura Ring 5:** The Verge calls it the best smart ring, a great casual health tracker, but cautions Oura users may not need an upgrade ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/964386/oura-ring-5-review-smart-ring-wearables)).
- **Xiaomi in US:** Despite not being banned, Xiaomi's phones are rarely sold in the US due to carrier and brand challenges ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2210461/why-xiaomi-not-banned-rarely-sold-usa/)).
- **Uber's AV Strategy:** Uber appears to be slowing autonomous vehicle adoption through policy influence, claiming it's fighting monopolies ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/ubers-autonomous-vehicle-strategy-slow-their-adoption/)).
- **iOS 27 Child Safety:** Apple announces new child safety features for iPhones, expanding parental controls ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/apple-child-safety-ios-27/)).

These developments underscore how regulation and market strategy are reshaping product availability and features.

AI.zh:
**概览**：AI监管抗议与商业化同步推进。OpenAI上线广告平台，澳洲电台疑似AI歌曲引争议，中国配音演员被迫自证非AI——信任危机与变现尝试并行。

- 超200人[围堵OpenAI和DeepMind办公室](https://news.google.)，要求暂停AI竞赛。同日OpenAI悄悄推出[广告平台](https://ads.openai.com/)，试图在对话界面嵌入赞助内容。
- 澳洲冠军单曲被质疑[AI生成](https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/jul/13/josh-fawaz-like-a-prayer-song-is-it-ai-radio)，引发创作伦理讨论。中国配音演员则[被迫自证人类](https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1018753/TheChineseVoiceActorForcedtoProveHe’sHuman)，AI语音克隆已威胁到职业生存。
- 开发者实现在3DS掌机上通过SSH运行[Claude Code](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48887733)，证明AI工具可以“降维”适配老旧硬件，拓展了开发者场景想象力。

**判断**：AI的“双速世界”正在形成——头部实验室疯狂变现，而公众与创作者的反抗声音越来越大，监管缺口或成为未来半年的主战场。
AI.en:
AI news was dominated by public protests, commercial moves, and identity dilemmas. OpenAI launched ads within ChatGPT, while protesters demanded regulation. Personal and cultural impacts emerged from AI-generated music and voice cloning.

- **Protests at OpenAI/DeepMind:** Over 200 protesters marched demanding a pause in the AI race and regulation ([MSN](https://news.google.), [Hindustan Times](https://news.google.)).
- **OpenAI Ads:** OpenAI launched advertising opportunities within ChatGPT, marking a shift toward monetization ([OpenAI](https://ads.openai.com/)).
- **AI Song on Australian Radio:** The top song on Australian radio is suspected to be AI-generated, raising questions about authenticity ([Guardian via HN](https://www.theguardian.com/music/2026/jul/13/josh-fawaz-like-a-prayer-song-is-it-ai-radio)).
- **Voice Actor vs AI Clones:** A Chinese voice actor is forced to continually prove he's human as AI clones of his voice proliferate ([Sixth Tone](https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1018753/TheChineseVoiceActorForcedtoProveHe%E2%80%99sHuman)).
- **Lorde Criticizes AI Glasses:** Performing at a festival, Lorde called Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses 'not sexy' ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/964539/lorde-says-ray-ban-meta-ai-glasses-are-not-sexy)).

The tension between commercial AI deployment and public resistance is intensifying, with creators and consumers caught in the middle.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
**概览**：社区热情集中在极简主义与复古技术。“Tiny Emulators”获180分高赞，一篇“Why Vanilla JS”引发99点讨论，同时开发者成功自研PCB。《Cyberpunk漫画》合集意外登顶。

- [Tiny Emulators](https://floooh.github.io/tiny8bit-preview/index.html)（180分）：在浏览器中模拟经典8位机，技术极简却引爆情怀。
- [Why Vanilla JS](https://guseyn.com/html/posts/why-vanilla-js.html)（99分，54条评论）：重提无框架开发，反映出部分开发者对现代前端复杂堆栈的厌倦。
- [设计并组装第一块PCB](https://vilkeliskis.com/b/2026/0711.html)（72分）：硬件初学者分享全流程，社区给予强烈共鸣。
- [Count Binface](https://countbinface.com/)（42分）：英国政治网红恶搞网站，被程序员社区当作文化符号传播。
- [Flash-MSA: 加速百万token训练](https://nanduruganesh.github.io/flash-msa/)（31分）：稀疏注意力内核优化，契合长文本AI算力痛点。

**判断**：HN当下情绪偏向“对抗复杂性”——无论是拒绝JS框架、回归原生汇编模拟，还是新手PCB成功，都指向一种去魅化的技术乐观。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community today celebrated maker culture and classic computing, with top-voted posts about tiny emulators, cyberpunk comics, and vanilla JavaScript. A mix of hardware projects and philosophical debates dominated the front page.

- **Tiny Emulators:** A collection of tiny 8-bit emulators in the browser garnered 180 points, demonstrating enduring interest in retro computing ([floooh.github.io](https://floooh.github.io/tiny8bit-preview/index.html)).
- **Cyberpunk Comics:** A curated list of cyberpunk comics, manga, and graphic novels received 120 points, reflecting community tastes ([shellzine.net](https://shellzine.net/cyberpunk-comics/)).
- **Vanilla JavaScript Advocacy:** A post arguing for vanilla JS over frameworks got 99 points and 54 comments, sparking debate ([guseyn.com](https://guseyn.com/html/posts/why-vanilla-js.html)).
- **Ask HN: What Are You Working On?:** The monthly thread saw 100 points and 298 comments, a snapshot of community projects ([HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48884984)).
- **PCB Design:** A personal account of designing and assembling a first PCB earned 72 points, highlighting DIY electronics enthusiasm ([vilkeliskis.com](https://vilkeliskis.com/b/2026/0711.html)).

The maker and retro computing trends on HN suggest a continued grassroots interest in understanding technology from the ground up.

汽车.zh:
**概览**：奔驰AMG CLA 45以680马力刷新性能边界，Volvo电动卡车进入游戏模拟器，Tesla FSD在欧洲谨慎推进，而Rivian销量超预期。

- 奔驰在Goodwood发布[AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/mercedes-amg-cla-45-arrives-in-goodwood-with-680-hp-and-three-axial-flux-motors/)，三台轴向磁通电机、680马力，标志着电动性能车进入军备竞赛。
- Volvo VNL/VNR电动卡车正式登陆[《美国卡车模拟器》](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/volvo-electric-semi-trucks-charge-up-american-truck-simulator/)，通过游戏推广零排放卡车，是一种低成本市场教育策略。
- 数据表明[Tesla FSD在数据上超越人类](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE1GT1doTnVsVUgtVlo1WGJ2Y0pyTHFNZWZiWDZPQkdkMk1tT3NsTk50a2Y4NlUzOGNPc0xzRlF6VmFScUdCamxWUkQwVG1xVXFlZ0RZTWc0TDRqMzd6WHV0ZzBmT1NOSmxYQnR3bVJn)，但欧洲仅逐国审批，碎片化合规仍是最大障碍。
- [Tesla与Rivian业绩超预期](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPaTBGYUNmTkNMNHNOaVctMEFUNE1ia0tRZFlsNFhOY1NqNnZnSTlHMndUYlZUMGVlSjgwa0dqM0pvbl9scWRvdjltLVB6blg0S1dSSVdXaXBBY2tFdWttOEV0bnVCZGZHRW0tSmdULTBtblV2OHZUMFlxTjJXV1pmM1ZLeGdNeHdvMXpZRE52ODY3bmpBUEg4Z29GM2dmXzZrQl82QXRNOVdObEo2blJGeXp4OA)，Ford与GM则面临季度压力，电动车竞争格局正在洗牌。

**判断**：豪华电动性能车与商用电动卡车均在加速普及，但自动驾驶的商业化落地仍被政策不确定性牵制。游戏与电动车的跨界营销正在成为新常态。
汽车.en:
Electric vehicle news was split between high-performance announcements and market data. Mercedes unveiled a stunning 680hp EV, while Tesla/Rivian outperformed legacy automakers in quarterly results. The simulation world also embraced electric trucks.

- **Mercedes AMG CLA 45:** Debuted at Goodwood with 680 hp and three axial-flux motors, marking a new era for electric performance sedans ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/mercedes-amg-cla-45-arrives-in-goodwood-with-680-hp-and-three-axial-flux-motors/)).
- **Tesla FSD Progress:** Europe approves Tesla's FSD border by border, while data shows FSD outperforms human drivers ([evxl.co](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE1GT1doTnVsVUgtVlo1WGJ2Y0pyTHFNZWZiWDZPQkdkMk1tT3NsTk50a2Y4NlUzOGNPc0xzRlF6VmFScUdCamxWUkQwVG1xVXFlZ0RZTWc0TDRqMzd6WHV0ZzBmT1NOSmxYQnR3bVJn)).
- **Tesla/Rivian Beat Expectations:** Tesla and Rivian exceeded Q2 expectations, while Ford and GM face a tough quarter ([Benzinga](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxPaTBGYUNmTkNMNHNOaVctMEFUNE1ia0tRZFlsNFhOY1NqNnZnSTlHMndUYlZUMGVlSjgwa0dqM0pvbl9scWRvdjltLVB6blg0S1dSSVdXaXBBY2tFdWttOEV0bnVCZGZHRW0tSmdULTBtblV2OHZUMFlxTjJXV1pmM1ZLeGdNeHdvMXpZRE52ODY3bmpBUEg4Z29GM2dmXzZrQl82QXRNOVdObEo2blJGeXp4OA)).
