- **Volvo Electric Semis in Game:** American Truck Simulator adds Volvo VNL and VNR Electric trucks, giving players a taste of electric trucking ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/volvo-electric-semi-trucks-charge-up-american-truck-simulator/)).
- **VMAX VX2 Lite E-Scooter:** Swiss company VMAX launches a full-suspension e-scooter at $799 with 56-mile range ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/12/vmax-launches-new-full-suspension-vx2-lite-e-scooter-for-a-mere-799/)).

The EV market is diverging: premium performance and strong financials for some, while others struggle; simulation games are normalizing electric vehicles.

篮球.zh: NBA休赛期进入疯狂期：文班亚马锁定5年2.52亿顶薪，马刺未来十年基石确定；黄蜂交易鲍尔后重建路径清晰，而前队友阿德巴约与希罗在拉斯维加斯发生冲突，折射热火更衣室暗涌。勇士聘请前湖人主帅[沃格尔担任首席助教](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49346659/sources-warriors-hire-frank-vogel-associate-head-coach)，填补斯托茨空缺；加里·特伦特[以4年6400万留守雄鹿](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337401/gary-trent-jr-agrees-4-year-64m-deal-stay-bucks)，稳定后场火力。中国篮球方面，[中国男篮遭绝杀暴露三后卫战术缺陷](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE83cTgxTEVsUU5aMXh3cm1sWHZYSkRIN3NXb05KUTNWZERpYlBmVGxUT2dfTkg3SEZGRXRvZXFyek51S1luUkdkLWs3cXpIRTg5dGVEaTRUWHZLVFdjRW1hVmlXbFBnQmxPLVJEdjJsdHJYZw)，[奥拉迪波自荐北京男篮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE05UzU5WjBvWHBXVWhpSmJ0aElfWHYwNG1tdzNoSjg1X0c2VXE5OWFPeDJwQmYySE84NlZJbkM4STUwLTZ1R2dGUnV3Q3VuOVFLWC1kaTdXOGFJN0RqeHB6S3lNaUJWWFNDbEJzYlFjX0w)成焦点，而[46岁斯科拉转型老板](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxOeFp2OHFqYzZ3ZzlVNnRGTlVaR0x0aVA3WXF3aDlTZ2cyS3dBNWZ2QlRDekd3bkl6NnpTcHY3SWRlTlVkQ3p1eEVtYUdPY2hKdXBDdnlNdUFmQ3JpeldhLWhoOVVCVXpRSWJHdWdlWEVhVW1aVS1SZkZ1VHpsRHNMWDdPYVdSNTZQNThKYQ)则让CBA球迷感慨。整体而言，NBA权力格局正在重塑，而中国篮球仍需耐心。
篮球.en:
The NBA offseason is in full swing with major contract extensions, trades, and off-court drama dominating headlines. An unprecedented rookie max extension, a point guard swap, and a physical altercation between former teammates are reshaping team rosters and narratives. Chinese basketball also draws attention with a national team heartbreak and a legend's new role.

- **Victor Wembanyama's $252M extension** locks in the Spurs' cornerstone and signals a long-term contender strategy in San Antonio. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328757/sources-spurs-victor-wembanyama-reach-252-million-max-extension))
- **LaMelo Ball trade to Hornets** – GM Jeff Peterson cited 'multiple goals' for the deal, aiming to build sustained success rather than short-term gain. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337303/ball-trade-help-hornets-compete-championships))
- **Ja Morant joins Trail Blazers**, looking to 'start fresh' and change his public image; the Grizzlies pivot to a new era. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49335942/ja-morant-says-joining-trail-blazers-starting-all-again))
- **Bam Adebayo struck Tyler Herro** during a Las Vegas practice altercation, raising questions about locker-room dynamics and potential league discipline. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49328387/heat-bam-adebayo-bucks-tyler-herro-got-physical-altercation-las-vegas))
- **Gary Trent Jr. stays with Bucks** on a 4-year, $64M deal, adding stability to Milwaukee's backcourt. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49337401/gary-trent-jr-agrees-4-year-64m-deal-stay-bucks))

**Signal**: With summer league showcasing No.1 pick AJ Dybantsa (23 points vs. Kings) and the Warriors hiring Frank Vogel as associate head coach, the NBA landscape is rapidly crystallizing—but lingering free-agent decisions on LeBron and Kawhi could still shift the balance of power.

足球.zh: 世界杯四强全由FIFA排名前四球队占据，[创下纪录](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49344988/fifa-top-4-teams-world-cup-semifinals-first)，半决赛阿根廷vs英格兰、西班牙vs法国看点十足。因凡蒂诺[提议64队扩军](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49345374/gianni-infantino-fifa-examine-64-team-world-cup-expansion)引发热议，同时[FIFA与FIFPRO商讨高温比赛协议](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49343877/fifa-world-cup-fifpro-temperature-heat-protocol-talks-sources)。英格兰晋级过程充满争议：挪威主帅指责电视线缆“助攻”英格兰扳平，[贝林厄姆力挺队友“脏赢”](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49338957/jude-bellingham-england-thomas-tuchel-criticism)，而[哈兰德父亲直言挪威被抢劫](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49341900/alf-inge-haaland-norway-robbed-world-cup-2026-england-well-done-referee-erling-haaland)。意大利足坛方面，[基耶萨致信尤文图斯表达离队愿望](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49345615/federico-chiesa-wrote-juventus-letter-leave-club-sources)加速转会市场。此外，网球领域的[辛纳卫冕温网](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cx2v84zje83o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)是今日跨界亮点，世界第一证明自己非昙花一现。足球世界正处于高强度叙事中，半决赛将决定新王归属。
足球.en:
The World Cup quarterfinals delivered high drama and set up a historic semifinal featuring the top four FIFA-ranked nations for the first time. Off-field developments include FIFA's consideration of a 64-team tournament, heat-protocol talks, and player union friction. Meanwhile, Wimbledon men's singles saw Jannik Sinner retain his title, and a 'Ted Lasso' actor made his professional soccer debut.

- **World Cup semifinals: Argentina vs. England, Spain vs. France** – Lionel Messi called Argentina's run 'not normal,' while England's Jude Bellingham praised his team's ability to 'win dirty.' ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49341436/lionel-messi-praises-not-normal-argentina-world-cup-semifinal-awaits), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49338957/jude-bellingham-england-thomas-tuchel-criticism))
- **Infantino confirms 64-team World Cup will be 'looked at'** after 2026, arguing football should be 'for the whole world.' ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cj9gm31jwg8o))
- **Norway coach fumes over TV wire goal assist** in England's equalizer; Alf-Inge Haaland claims Norway were 'robbed.' ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49339911/norway-head-coach-fumes-clear-tv-cable-assist-england-goal-jude-bellingham), [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49341900/alf-inge-haaland-norway-robbed-world-cup-2026-england-well-done-referee-erling-haaland))
- **FIFA and FIFPRO in heat-protocol talks** to prevent excessive-temperature matches, a critical issue for future tournaments. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49343877/fifa-world-cup-fifpro-temperature-heat-protocol-talks-sources))
- **'Ted Lasso' actor Cristo Fernández makes USL debut** for El Paso in the 79th minute, drawing crossover attention. ([ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49344890/ted-lasso-dani-rojas-actor-cristo-fernandez-usl-debut))

**Signal**: England's contentious quarterfinal win and Harry Kane's call for a 'higher level' set up a must-watch semifinal against Argentina, while the expanded World Cup proposal could radically reshape the sport's global calendar.

虎扑社区动态.zh: 虎扑社区今日热度集中在世界杯与NBA夏季联赛。[FIFA实力榜更新](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOLUVMbFFRX0IxZUdEeU1uSHV0ZXdPRnNnSjdLRmRQdDk5dERfeE9zTk9ZOTZGNUgxU1BTdXpZMy1NQ1dnZ1dOMGIwTEhmZlFURDNQckFMV1JoSktKc1F0SXBSb3FuS3VNR0lGVDJlemg3SUN5cS14ckxqM2VPSk9EN3dWSXVVaTd2Q0RnOVM4aWdNZw)显示姆巴佩、贝林厄姆、梅西领跑进攻榜，与世界杯四强高度重合。状元[迪班萨在夏季联赛砍下27+7](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)被热议，或为夏季联赛谢幕演出。电竞方面[STE末局逆袭夺冠](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBJTjJSeXRwQTVhcjNtanRhVEF2SUJSTElfaE5reU9NU2JGTXFSRUFnZWlyS2ZWdDlyX1Fxc0FvMkw3UGZWRXh6N29YY0c2Y3dlN094T0l3)，积分榜竞争激烈。登贝莱[超预期进球表现](https://news.google.)成为战术讨论热点。社区情绪整体亢奋，但部分帖子对国篮表现感到沮丧。后续可关注世界杯半决赛前虎扑前瞻分析以及夏季联赛新秀评分。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Chinese fan communities are abuzz with World Cup analysis, NBA summer league highlights, and domestic basketball news. The upcoming Spain vs. Belgium semifinal preview and AJ Dybantsa's strong summer league performance are top talking points, alongside a STE esports title win.

- **FIFA World Cup power rankings** updated: Mbappé, Bellingham, and Messi lead offensive charts, fueling fan debates. ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOLUVMbFFRX0IxZUdEeU1uSHV0ZXdPRnNnSjdLRmRQdDk5dERfeE9zTk9ZOTZGNUgxU1BTdXpZMy1NQ1dnZ1dOMGIwTEhmZlFURDNQckFMV1JoSktKc1F0SXBSb3FuS3VNR0lGVDJlemg3SUN5cS14ckxqM2VPSk9EN3dWSXVVaTd2Q0RnOVM4aWdNZw))
- **AJ Dybantsa posts 27-point summer league highlight** – the No.1 pick's ins performance draws widespread admiration. ([MSN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_))
- **Spain vs. Belgium semifinal preview** – a clash of styles ('spear vs. shield') analyzed in depth. ([MSN](https://news.google.))
- **STE esports team stages final-round comeback** to win the tournament, with top-five teams closely packed. ([腾讯新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBJTjJSeXRwQTVhcjNtanRhVEF2SUJSTElfaE5reU9NU2JGTXFSRUFnZWlyS2ZWdDlyX1Fxc0FvMkw3UGZWRXh6N29YY0c2Y3dlN094T0l3))
- **Jannik Sinner beats Djokovic to reach Wimbledon final** (reported as 'flowing news'), reinforcing his dominance. ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE00LUxVM3pHUnEtWHk1VFpFWVFzTUdObHQta1g1eTZXa1o4TGduMmNDdEFBSW9YaE9mYm45NGMtdXNoYTVWQXhaaUR5M2NReDVIUV9pWmREQXd4aXkweVZjcFZPXzVHVmR2TEZBSkk4MFJYZw))

**Signal**: Hupu users are closely tracking both the World Cup and NBA summer league, indicating a passionate cross-sport fanbase that thrives on instant analysis and highlight sharing.

欧美.zh: 【欧美】周星驰暌违七年导演作品《功夫女足》中国首周末2天票房7.4亿人民币，好莱坞报道指其本土票房有望超3.5亿美元，美国发行正在洽谈中。与此同时，Jay-Z纽约洋基体育场第三夜因安全漏洞延迟四小时，Variety称数百粉丝试图冲门，Jay最终登台致歉。真人秀方面，《Love Island USA》第八季冠军由Bryce与Trinity摘得，Peacock随即宣布8月31日举办由Andy Cohen与Ariana Madix主持的重聚特辑，且衍生节目《Beyond the Villa》已续订第三季。悼念消息：参演《了不起的麦瑟尔夫人》的百老汇演员Josh Grisetti自杀身亡，享年44岁；参议员Lindsey Graham因主动脉夹层去世（虽为政治人物，但Deadline将其归入娱乐版，或因其与好莱坞关系密切）。此外，Sacha Baron Cohen以Ali G形象突袭温网决赛，引发社交媒体狂欢。
欧美.en:
The US and European entertainment scene saw major events: Stephen Chow's China box office triumph, Jay-Z's concert chaos, and Love Island USA's finale. Tragedy struck the reality show's production team, while a surprise appearance by Ali G at Wimbledon added levity.

- **[Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Soccer' Kicks Off With Mighty $74M Two-Day Debut at China Box Office](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/stephen-chow-kung-fu-soccer-china-box-office-1236646255/)** – The film is projected to earn $350M+ in China, with a U.S. release still in the works. This marks Chow's first directorial effort in seven years.
- **[Jay-Z's Third Yankee Stadium Concert Plagued by Hours-Long Delay After Security Breach](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/jay-z-yankee-stadium-concert-delay-security-breach-1236809269/)** – Fans rushing the gates caused a nearly four-hour wait; Jay-Z apologized and the show eventually went on.
- **[Love Island USA Season 8 Crowns Its Winners](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bryce-trinity-win-love-island-usa-season-8-1236807453/)** – Bryce and Trinity won the Peacock series. A reunion hosted by Andy Cohen and Ariana Madix airs August 31.
- **[Ariana Madix Pays Tribute To Late 'Love Island USA' Producer James Barker](https://deadline.com/2026/07/ariana-madix-tribute-love-island-usa-producer-james-barker-1236980394/)** – Barker's unexpected death during production was mourned by Madix and the cast; a crowdfunding campaign has been launched.
- **[Sacha Baron Cohen's Ali G Makes Surprise Appearance at Wimbledon](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/sacha-baron-cohen-ali-g-surprise-appearance-wimbledon-1236646214/)** – The character's trademark humor entertained the tennis crowd, marking Cohen's first public outing as Ali G in years.

This West-heavy update shows a mix of blockbuster film performance, reality TV drama, and live event mishaps – all shaping the entertainment conversation.

日韩.zh: 【日韩】韩流综艺与剧集持续输出：tvN《Goblin》十周年特辑于7月12日收官，孔刘、李栋旭等原班人马重聚旅行引发集体回忆；《The Village Barber》第二季确认将在8月底开拍，朴宝剑、李相二、高庚杓加盟，延续治愈路线。新约会生存综艺《All or Nothing》公开预告，利特、神童、DAWN、Johnny、金曜汉与Jisung将赴埃及争夺“王子”称号。SBS大胆推出《Love Against Time》，让患有绝症或濒死经历的20-30代青年重新面对爱情，MC阵容包括李世荣、CNBLUE郑容和、SEVENTEEN DK与Yena。音乐方面，ENHYPEN将于7月23-24日亮相圣迭戈动漫展，并与《暮光之城》作者及演员同台，介绍其原创故事IP“DARK MOON”；xikers第二轮日本粉丝见面会售罄，印证全球人气。
日韩.en:
Korean entertainment is buzzing with new variety shows, drama reunions, and a K-pop group's global event appearance. 'Guardian: The Lonely and Great God' cast wrapped a nostalgic trip, while ENHYPEN prepares for Comic-Con.

- **[Hwang In Youp And Hyeri Reunite 15 Years After Their High School Romance In 'Dream To You'](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854098wpp/hwang-in-youp-and-hyeri-reunite-15-years-after-their-high-school-romance-in-dream-to-you)** – The ENA romantic comedy offers a nostalgic reunion plot, generating early buzz.
- **['The Village Barber' Season 2 Confirms Premiere Plans And Cast Park Bo Gum, Lee Sang Yi, And Ko Kyung Pyo](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854200wpp/the-village-barber-season-2-confirms-premiere-plans-and-cast-park-bo-gum-lee-sang-yi-and-ko-kyung-pyo)** – The tvN variety show returns with a star-studded lineup, filming set for late August.
- **['Guardian: The Lonely And Great God' Cast Concludes 10th Anniversary Trip With Heartfelt Farewells](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854112wpp/guardian-the-lonely-and-great-god-cast-concludes-10th-anniversary-trip-with-heartfelt-farewells)** – The special program celebrated the iconic drama's legacy, drawing emotional reactions from fans.
- **[ENHYPEN To Perform At Comic-Con + Attend Panel With 'Twilight' Author And Actors](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854053wpp/enhypen-to-perform-at-comic-con-attend-panel-with-twilight-author-and-actors)** – The K-pop group will present their 'DARK MOON' franchise at San Diego Comic-Con, bridging music and fandom.
- **[Lee Se Young, CNBLUE's Jung Yong Hwa, SEVENTEEN's DK, And Yena Confirmed As MCs For New Dating Reality Show 'Love Against Time'](https://www.soompi.com/article/1854106wpp/lee-se-young-cnblues-jung-yong-hwa-seventeens-dk-and-yena-confirmed-as-mcs-for-new-dating-reality-show-love-against-time)** – SBS's novel format involves participants with terminal illness histories, aiming for emotional resonance.

Korea's entertainment engine keeps rolling with nostalgia, fresh variety concepts, and global fandom integration.

中国.zh: 【中国】周星驰《功夫女足》一枝独秀，7月12日天津路演主创与观众热情互动，影片已创下多项国产喜剧票房纪录。张婧仪就中国影视剧海外热播表态，称“很开心中剧受海外观众喜爱”，反映出海趋势持续。暴雪中国裁员引发行业震动，总部认为裁员可优化管理能力，但国内游戏从业者担忧寒意蔓延。AI对影视行业的冲击成为显性焦虑：世界新闻网报道称中国演员集体“求工作”，担心被AI替代。此外，王鹤棣亮相NBA全明星周末名人赛，跨界破圈；白敬亭被指将明星潮牌经营成正规服装公司，商业版图受关注；迪丽热巴豪華行程曝光，或将同台刘亦菲、杨幂，引发梦幻联动期待。上海国际电影节金爵奖新闻发布会召开，为后续影展预热。
中国.en:
China's entertainment landscape is marked by box office fireworks, AI-driven industry anxiety, and celebrity brand expansion. Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Soccer' dominates, while actors voice concerns over technology replacing human roles.

- **[周星驰《功夫女足》热映创多项纪录 天津路演主创观众双向奔赴 (Stephen Chow's 'Kung Fu Soccer' Breaks Records, Tianjin Roadshow)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1Yb3N5S3NaeWV2Q1FveTVUdzh5NEdwQ05PZWdlclhsOEE2RHRDdFpvd3YxVjdPWTU0Rm9jaUpYT21lazJMM0JwZmdfTnRXT0I4a1RpWXJyYkg4ajg)** – The film's success is generating massive buzz, with Zhang Xiaofei's performance sparking online debate.
- **[娛樂／AI太衝擊 中國演員集體「求工作」 (AI Impact: Chinese Actors 'Seek Work' Collectively)](https://news.google.)** – A report highlights widespread anxiety among Chinese performers as AI begins to replace extras and minor roles.
- **[王鹤棣亮相NBA全明星周末名人赛 (Wang Hedi Appears at NBA All-Star Celebrity Game)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE53NmhUeXQ4cDhzVHlULWFCR1VLRFNmSDJHSDE1WF9oalNhdEY2Z3dWUVl4MHJ2bjU2NGpoLUZXdzJqaDJ1eUJhUmJjQ1d5ZWVKTzg1QVNqRm5SOUtkNVNIYmpjczdnX3JsRlhvUV9GZGZFZw)** – The Chinese actor's cross-continent appearance reflects growing celebrity crossover with global sports events.
- **[迪丽热巴豪华行程曝光！同台刘亦菲杨幂 (Dilraba Dilmurat's Luxury Schedule Revealed; On Stage with Liu Yifei and Yang Mi)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1vM0VScEFxeGZ4cnZMd05UeFUtcE1oYlI5NnhKeUhEQnJaeE14bS1KTW9mdGNOTzNybzVpd0hldGZZZU9mT1NDajRIcm1fc3lHQS1paUpvSVBuMW1GUHo0ZmF1YU9RdHBMMnVONVRXM2JRZw)** – The star-studded lineup signals a major fan-attracting event, likely for a TV gala.
- **[暴雪中国裁员 总部认为这反而能优化管理能力 (Blizzard China Lays Off Staff; HQ Says It Optimizes Management)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9jbnRpemRLVF81dDlCNENuNnlnRkNYbzZocFZQUk83dy1ZaVhaTlUzMU5OeFZvdGhiR3JfakZaMllhYmFPRjNIcjE0S2FfME9TZGVLaUxyQWR2emVFN3VCaHNR)** – The layoffs add to the narrative of a shifting entertainment and gaming ecosystem in China.

China's entertainment narrative is split between celebratory box office wins and structural concerns about AI and corporate restructuring.
